name: Metrogyl 400mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About METROGYL 400MG TABLET

METROGYL 400MG TABLET is used in the management of various bacterial and parasitic infections such as bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection), trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections, blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area infections, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It helps to manage an infection after surgery.

You can take METROGYL 400MG TABLET at any time of the day after food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Your symptoms may get better after a short time but do not stop taking it until you have finished a full course of treatment, even if you feel well. If you stop taking it early, some bacteria may survive, and the infection may come back. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking METROGYL 400MG TABLET and for a few days after stopping it. Otherwise, you may get unpleasant side effects like nausea, vomiting, and stomach pain.

Before taking METROGYL 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. METROGYL 400MG TABLET is used in a high dose or for a prolonged time increases the risk of side effects such as nerve damage. Take it only as prescribed by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking METROGYL 400MG TABLET are headache, lack of appetite, nausea, dryness in mouth, metallic taste in mouth, stomach cramps and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you. You can try using sugarless candies or lozenges to overcome any dryness or metallic taste in the mouth.
usesDetails:
Uses Of METROGYL 400MG TABLET

METROGYL 400MG TABLET is used to manage the following infection conditions:

Bacterial infections
Parasitic infections
Benefits of METROGYL 400MG TABLET:

1. Management of Bacterial infections:

METROGYL 400MG TABLET is a versatile antibiotic medicine that can be used to manage many different infections caused by bacteria. These include manage infections of the blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It can also be used to manage bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection).

2. Management of Parasitic infections:

METROGYL 400MG TABLET is an antibiotic medicine that helps many parasitic infections such as trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections and amoebic dysentery. It works by stopping the growth of parasites causing the infection. This medicine usually makes you feel better quite quickly. However, you should continue taking it as long as it is prescribed even when you feel better, to make sure that all parasites are killed and do not become resistant.
mechanismOfAction:
How METROGYL 400MG TABLET Works

METROGYL 400MG TABLET contains a medicine called Metronidazole which is an antiprotozoal drug that kills bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. As a result, it kills the infection-causing germs and controls their future growth and multiplication, reducing the severity of the infection.
usageInstructions: Take METROGYL 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow METROGYL 400MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken after food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to infection may come back.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not consume alcohol during the course of treatment and for at least 48 hours after finishing the medication.
Inform Your Doctor if you have or had conditions such as kidney, liver and other neurological disorders like seizures or peripheral neuropathy

sideEffects: Stomach pain, lack of appetite, nausea, vomiting, fever, tiredness, weakness, jaundice (yellowing of skin and whites of the eye), dark urine, putty or mastic-coloured stools, skin itchiness
Signs of severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat or tongue causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

Severe skin reactions (such as widespread skin rash, blistering, peeling or bleeding on any part of the skin with fever, chills, enlarged lymph nodes and malaise or pink or reddish skin lesions on palms or soles)
Signs of brain disease called encephalopathy (such as fever, stiff neck, headache, seeing things which aren’t there, confusion, difficulties in using your arms and legs, problems with speaking)
Signs of blood disease (such as unexpected infections, mouth ulcers, bruising, gum bleeding, or severe tiredness)
Signs of a liver problem (such as yellowing of skin and eyes)
Severe stomach pain which may reach through to your back (signs of inflammation in the pancreas)
sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of METROGYL 400MG TABLET

Like all medicines, METROGYL 400MG TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them.

Most Common Side Effects of METROGYL 400MG TABLET are:
Headache
Lack of appetite
Nausea
Dryness in mouth
Metallic taste in mouth
Stomach cramps
Dizziness

Stop taking METROGYL 400MG TABLET and consult your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Stomach pain, lack of appetite, nausea, vomiting, fever, tiredness, weakness, jaundice (yellowing of skin and whites of the eye), dark urine, putty or mastic-coloured stools, skin itchiness
Signs of severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, throat or tongue causing difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Severe skin reactions (such as widespread skin rash, blistering, peeling or bleeding on any part of the skin with fever, chills, enlarged lymph nodes and malaise or pink or reddish skin lesions on palms or soles)
Signs of brain disease called encephalopathy (such as fever, stiff neck, headache, seeing things which aren’t there, confusion, difficulties in using your arms and legs, problems with speaking)
Signs of blood disease (such as unexpected infections, mouth ulcers, bruising, gum bleeding, or severe tiredness)
Signs of a liver problem (such as yellowing of skin and eyes)
Severe stomach pain which may reach through to your back (signs of inflammation in the pancreas)

warnings.details: METROGYL 400MG TABLET is generally considered safe to use during pregnancy. While there are limited human studies, animal research has shown low or no adverse effects to the developing baby. Please consult with your doctor for further guidance.
METROGYL 400MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not suitable for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness, hallucination, or confusion while taking this medicine.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with METROGYL 400MG TABLET as it may cause unpleasant side effects such as nausea and vomiting, stomach pain, hot flashes, irregular heartbeat, thirst, and headache.
METROGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (including dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
METROGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Dose adjustment of METROGYL 400MG TABLET may be needed. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take METROGYL 400MG TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Metronidazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.
METROGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
METROGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking METROGYL 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have any diseases affecting your nervous system
Have Cockayne syndrome (a rare genetic disorder characterized by short stature, low intellectual ability and neurological problems)
Have blood dyscrasias (a blood condition affecting blood components, bone marrow, lymph and blood vessels)
Have a history of seizures

name: Tiniba 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TINIBA 500MG TABLET

TINIBA 500MG TABLET is used in the management of post-operative infections caused by anaerobic bacteria, especially those associated with colonic, gastrointestinal and gynecological surgery. It is also used to manage intraperitoneal infections, gynecological infections, bacterial septicemia, post-operative wound infections, skin and soft tissue infections, upper and lower respiratory tract infections, non-specific vaginitis, acute ulcerative gingivitis, urogenital trichomoniasis in both male and female patients, giardiasis, intestinal amebiasis, amebic involvement of the liver. It contains Tinidazole which belongs to the group of medicines known as Anti-protozoals. It works against anaerobic bacteria and protozoa is believed to involve the penetration of the medicine into the cell of the microorganism and subsequent damage of DNA strands or inhibition of their synthesis.

TINIBA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with organic neurological disorders and blood dyscrasias. TINIBA 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. It is not recommended for patients with first trimester in pregnancy. TINIBA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mother.

There is no proper data available for the use of TINIBA 500MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effect of taking TINIBA 500MG TABLET are decreased appetite, headache, vertigo, vomiting, diarrhoea, nausea or abdominal pain. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

How TINIBA 500MG TABLET Works

TINIBA 500MG TABLET contains Tinidazole which is a 5-nitroimidazole derivative of the substituted imidazole compounds and possesses antimicrobial activity against anaerobic bacteria and protozoa. The mode of action of tinidazole against anaerobic bacteria and protozoa is believed to involve the penetration of the drug into the cell of the microorganism and subsequent damage of DNA strands or inhibition of their synthesis.
usageDetails:
How to use TINIBA 500MG TABLET

Take TINIBA 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. It is recommended that TINIBA 500MG TABLET should be taken during or after a meal. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TINIBA 500MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

TINIBA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TINIBA 500MG TABLET.
There is no evidence to suggest that TINIBA 500MG TABLET may affect these abilities.
Concurrent use of TINIBA 500MG TABLET and alcohol may produce a disulfiram-like reaction and should be avoided.

Dosage adjustment in patients with impaired renal function are generally not necessary. However, because TINIBA 500MG TABLET is easily removed by haemodialysis, patients may require additional doses of TINIBA 500MG TABLET to compensate. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions do I need to follow while taking TINIBA 500MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: TINIBA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with organic neurological disorders and blood dyscrasias. TINIBA 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. It is not recommended for patients with first trimester in pregnancy. TINIBA 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mother.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if I stop taking TINIBA 500MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Do not stop taking TINIBA 500MG TABLET without talking to your doctor first. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: Is TINIBA 500MG TABLET safe to use in patients with kidney problems?
faqs.answer: A: Dosage adjustment in patients with impaired renal function are generally not necessary. However, because TINIBA 500MG TABLET is easily removed by haemodialysis, patients may require additional doses of TINIBA 500MG TABLET to compensate. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

faqs.question: Q: How long should TINIBA 500MG TABLET be taken?
faqs.answer: A: Take TINIBA 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It is recommended that TINIBA 500MG TABLET should be taken during or after a meal.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take TINIBA 500MG TABLET milk?
faqs.answer: A: Take TINIBA 500MG TABLET with food, including with milk, to lower your risk of stomach discomfort. But keep in mind that dairy products, like milk, are high in fat, which might cause some people to feel nauseous. This might worsen the side effects of the medicine. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: How long does TINIBA 500MG TABLET stay in the body?
faqs.answer: A: It can take between 2-3 days for most of TINIBA 500MG TABLET to leave the body. It is estimated based on the half-life of TINIBA 500MG TABLET. The medication stays in your system can also depend on your age and your health conditions, so it can be different for each individual person.

faqs.question: Q: Is TINIBA 500MG TABLET a strong antibiotic?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. TINIBA 500MG TABLET is an antibiotic effective against various bacterial infections in the intestines and vagina.

faqs.question: Q: Can TINIBA 500MG TABLET cure yeast infections?
faqs.answer: A: It is not typically used to manage yeast infections. It is primarily effective against bacterial infections. Consult your doctor if you experience vaginal itching or discharge.

faqs.question: Q: Can TINIBA 500MG TABLET be taken with alcohol?
faqs.answer: A: Avoid consuming alcohol while taking TINIBA 500MG TABLET and for at least 3 days after completing the course, as it may cause severe reactions like nausea, vomiting, and headache.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET
Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET Works

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET

Take NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

Anemia (fatigue, skin pallor, shortness of breath, dizziness or fast heartbeat due to damage to bone marrow causing deficiency of the red blood cells)
Signs of liver failure which may be fatal (yellow coloured skin and eyes along with stomach pain and swelling)

Fever, chills, cough and shortness of breath (reaction of lung with the medicine within a week or very slowly, mainly in elderly patients)
Yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes (inflammation of the liver causing jaundice)

Severe reduction in blood cells which results in weakness, bruising or more instance of infections

Signs of autoimmune hepatitis (jaundice, fatigue, abdominal pain, joint pain and swelling)

It can be used with caution in pregnant women or are planning to have a baby. However, consult your doctor before taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET.

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution for breastfeeding women and should be avoided particularly for infant with known or suspected with erythrocyte enzyme deficiency (including G6PD deficiency) as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET because it might make you dizzier.

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease that severely affects the function of kidneys. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET.
NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET.
Do not take NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET if you are allergic to nitrofurantoin.
NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET.

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (under 6 years of age) and infants above 3 months of age. It is not recommended for infants below three months of age. However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.
NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET.

Others

NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are suffering from a blood disorder called porphyria (build-up of certain chemicals related to red blood cell that affects skin and nerve function)
Are deficient in an enzyme called g6pd (glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase) that causes in abdomen or back pain, fatigue, dark urine, pallor, or yellow skin and eyes

Before taking NITROFUR SR 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)
Have anaemia (a decrease in red blood cells that causes pale skin, weakness and breathlessness)
Are suffering from any illness causing severe weakness
Lack of vitamin B (especially that results in fatigue, mouth sores, diarrhoea, and depression)
Have abnormal electrolyte levels in your blood

name: Linokem 600mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LINOKEM 600MG TABLET

LINOKEM 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINOKEM 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINOKEM 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINOKEM 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINOKEM 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How LINOKEM 600MG TABLET Works

LINOKEM 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LINOKEM 600MG TABLET

Take LINOKEM 600MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LINOKEM 600MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LINOKEM 600MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINOKEM 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: LINOKEM 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or problems with your vision after taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol (especially draught beers and wine) while taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET.

LINOKEM 600MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET.

LINOKEM 600MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition that affects the blood, bone marrow, or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET.

Have an overactive thyroid

Bruise and bleed easily
Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhea

Have any scheduled surgery

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINOKEM 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LINOKEM 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

LIZOLID 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LIZOLID 600MG TABLET

Take LIZOLID 600MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LIZOLID 600MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LIZOLID 600MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LIZOLID 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

LIZOLID 600MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition that affects the blood, bone marrow, or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking LIZOLID 600MG TABLET.

Others

Have an overactive thyroid
Have an adrenal gland tumor (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome (tumors of the hormone system causing diarrhea, flushing of the skin, and wheezing)
Have mental disorders such as manic depression, schizoaffective disorder, mental confusion, or other mental problems
Bruise and bleed easily
Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhea
Have phenylketonuria (a rare genetic disorder that causes certain amino acids to build up in the body)
Have any scheduled surgery

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LIZOLID 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LIZOLID 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LIZOLID 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About METROGYL 200MG TABLET

METROGYL 200MG TABLET is used in the management of various bacterial and parasitic infections such as bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection), trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections, blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area infections, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It helps to manage an infection after surgery.

You can take METROGYL 200MG TABLET at any time of the day after food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Your symptoms may get better after a short time but do not stop taking it until you have finished a full course of treatment, even if you feel well. If you stop taking it early, some bacteria may survive, and the infection may come back. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking METROGYL 200MG TABLET and for a few days after stopping it. Otherwise, you may get unpleasant side effects like nausea, vomiting, and stomach pain.

Before taking METROGYL 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. METROGYL 200MG TABLET is used in a high dose or for a prolonged time increases the risk of side effects such as nerve damage. Take it only as prescribed by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking METROGYL 200MG TABLET are headache, lack of appetite, nausea, dryness in mouth, metallic taste in mouth, stomach cramps and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you. You can try using sugarless candies or lozenges to overcome any dryness or metallic taste in the mouth.
usesDetails:
Uses Of METROGYL 200MG TABLET

METROGYL 200MG TABLET is used to manage the following infection conditions:

Bacterial infections
Parasitic infections
Benefits of METROGYL 200MG TABLET:

1. Management of Bacterial infections:

METROGYL 200MG TABLET is a versatile antibiotic medicine that can be used to manage many different infections caused by bacteria. These include manage infections of the blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It can also be used to manage bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection).

2. Management of Parasitic infections:

METROGYL 200MG TABLET is an antibiotic medicine that helps many parasitic infections such as trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections and amoebic dysentery. It works by stopping the growth of parasites causing the infection. This medicine usually makes you feel better quite quickly. However, you should continue taking it as long as it is prescribed even when you feel better, to make sure that all parasites are killed and do not become resistant.
mechanismOfAction:
How METROGYL 200MG TABLET Works

METROGYL 200MG TABLET contains a medicine called Metronidazole which is an antiprotozoal drug that kills bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. As a result, it kills the infection-causing germs and controls their future growth and multiplication, reducing the severity of the infection.

introduction:
Introduction About METROGYL 400 TABLET

Metrogyl 400 Tablet is commonly used for managing certain bacterial and protozoal infections. This medicine contains metronidazole, a trusted ingredient recognized for its effectiveness against infections of the stomach, intestines, gums, skin, joints, and other body parts. It is also commonly prescribed in scenarios such as dental infections, post-surgical care, or when specific parasitic infections like amoebiasis and giardiasis are identified by a healthcare provider. The use of this tablet is guided by a medical professional after a thorough assessment of your symptoms and laboratory results.

This medicine is typically suited for adults and adolescents who have been diagnosed with infections sensitive to metronidazole. Patients who may benefit from Metrogyl 400 include those dealing with stomach or intestinal infections, certain dental or gum issues, or infections after surgery. The dose and length of therapy depend on your age, the type of infection, and your doctor’s advice. In general, Metrogyl 400 is taken orally, preferably after meals to reduce stomach discomfort. It should be swallowed whole with water as per the schedule and dosage prescribed by your healthcare provider. It is important not to skip doses or stop the course early, even if symptoms improve, to avoid incomplete clearing of the infection.

Some important precautions need to be followed while using Metrogyl 400. Avoid alcohol during therapy and for at least 48 hours after the last dose, as combining with alcohol can cause unpleasant reactions (such as flushing, nausea, or rapid heartbeat). Let your doctor know about any existing medical conditions, especially if you have liver problems, a history of blood disorders, or nervous system issues. Regular monitoring may be recommended if you require prolonged treatment. Follow the directions for use and do not share your medicine with anyone else.

For pregnancy and breastfeeding, Metrogyl 400 should only be used on doctor’s advice. While some research suggests it can be used when clearly needed, inform your doctor if you are pregnant, planning to become pregnant, or breastfeeding, so they can weigh the benefits and possible risks. Common side effects reported with Metrogyl 400 include nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, metallic taste in the mouth, headache, and, sometimes, dizziness. Most side effects are mild and temporary, but any severe or persistent symptoms should be brought to your doctor’s attention promptly. Always keep your doctor informed about all your medicines and supplements before starting Metrogyl 400.

mechanismOfAction:
How METROGYL 400 TABLET Works
Metrogyl 400 mechanism of action

Metrogyl 400 Tablet contains metronidazole, a nitroimidazole compound that acts as a prodrug requiring biochemical reduction to become active. Once inside susceptible bacteria and protozoa—especially those thriving in low-oxygen (anaerobic) environments—the drug is converted into reactive metabolites by microbial enzymes. These metabolites interact with microbial DNA, causing DNA strand breaks and inhibiting nucleic acid synthesis. This action disrupts essential DNA functions, preventing bacteria and parasites from multiplying and ultimately resulting in their elimination. Human cells and aerobic bacteria are largely unaffected because the activation process requires a low-oxygen environment unique to anaerobic pathogens.

How Metrogyl 400 Targets Bacteria and Parasites

Metrogyl 400 is specifically effective against a wide range of anaerobic bacteria and protozoal pathogens. The unique property of these microbes to activate metronidazole ensures targeted action: the drug is taken up by the pathogen, where it undergoes reduction to generate powerful intermediates that bind to and damage its DNA. This targeted mechanism means that the medicine disrupts only the DNA of specific bacteria and protozoa, sparing most healthy cells and beneficial microbial flora. As a result, Metrogyl 400 is a preferred choice for conditions like gastrointestinal, dental, skin, and reproductive tract infections caused by anaerobic bacteria and certain protozoa (including amoebiasis, giardiasis, and trichomoniasis). The drug’s selectivity and ability to reach effective concentrations in tissues make it a reliable agent for broad-spectrum infection control while minimizing the impact on the body’s natural systems.
usageInstructions: Follow your healthcare provider’s prescription: Dosage and duration depend on age, specific infection, and medical condition.
Typical adult dose: Often 400 mg two or three times daily, adjusted based on infection type.
Pediatric use: Dose is weight-based and set by the doctor—do not estimate or alter.
Timing: Take at evenly spaced intervals (e.g., every 8 or 12 hours) for consistent levels in the body.
Full course: Complete the entire prescribed duration, even if symptoms improve earlier.
Swallow whole: Do not chew, break, or crush the tablet.
Take with or after food: This helps reduce the chance of stomach upset.

introduction:
Introduction About VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION

VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION contains Vancomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Glycopeptide antibiotics. It is used for the management of serious infections caused by susceptible strains of methicillin-resistant (beta-lactam-resistant) staphylococci bacteria.

VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION is used for the management of endocarditis (infection to the inner lining of heart with symptoms of fever, chills, difficulty in breathing etc) as well as is used for the management of hospital acquired pneumonia, infections of skin and tissues below skin, bone and joints (involves osteomyelitis, arthritis, spinal infections etc with symptoms of pain, fever, chills, swelling in joints etc).

Also, it is used to manage central nervous system infection (meningitis, abscess, brain enlargement with symptoms of headache, fever, mood changes) and blood caused by bacteria. Symptoms of these infections are usually recurrent fever and chills, headache and difficulty in breathing. VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION is also used to manage infections in patients who are allergic to the medicines containing penicillin and cephalosporins.

Before receiving VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION, your doctor will do few blood tests to determine the exact cause of infection. It should be used only to manage infections that are proven or strongly suspected to be caused by susceptible bacteria.

VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION is not recommended in patients who have hypersensitivity to vancomycin.

Before receiving VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION inform your doctor if you have kidney diseases or hearing diseases. VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION should be used in caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The common side effects of receiving VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION include difficulty in breathing, fall in blood pressure, redness of body and face, fever, etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen with time.

Blood disorders
Sensitive to any food or medicine

Use in pediatrics:

VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION should be used with caution in with particular care in premature infants and young infants, because their kidneys are not fully developed and they may accumulate VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION in the blood. This age group may need blood tests for controlling vancomycin levels in blood. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION is used with caution in elderly people with kidney diseases, hearing diseases and those who are undergoing dialysis. Your doctor will do blood test and hearing test during management with VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION. Lower dose of VANCOGRAM 1GM INJECTION is advised for elder people. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

name: Linzon 600mg Tablet 6'S
introduction:
Introduction About LINZON 600MG TABLET

LINZON 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINZON 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINZON 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINZON 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINZON 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINZON 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINZON 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How LINZON 600MG TABLET Works

LINZON 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

How to use LINZON 600MG TABLET

Take LINZON 600MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LINZON 600MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LINZON 600MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINZON 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINZON 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LINZON 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About FOSIROL SACHET

FOSIROL SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

FOSIROL SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

FOSIROL SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. FOSIROL SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man

mechanismOfAction:
How FOSIROL SACHET Works

FOSIROL SACHET works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

Take FOSIROL SACHET as advised by your physician. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Nitrobest Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About NITROBEST TABLET

NITROBEST TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NITROBEST TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NITROBEST TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NITROBEST TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NITROBEST TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITROBEST TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROBEST TABLET
Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROBEST TABLET Works

NITROBEST TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROBEST TABLET

Take NITROBEST TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow NITROBEST TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. NITROBEST TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking NITROBEST TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITROBEST TABLET because it might make you dizzier.

NITROBEST TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking NITROBEST TABLET.
Do not take NITROBEST TABLET if you are allergic to nitrofurantoin.
NITROBEST TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking NITROBEST TABLET.

NITROBEST TABLET should be used with caution in children (under 6 years of age) and infants above 3 months of age. It is not recommended for infants below three months of age. However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.
NITROBEST TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking NITROBEST TABLET.

Others

NITROBEST TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are suffering from a blood disorder called porphyria (build-up of certain chemicals related to red blood cell that affects skin and nerve function)
Are deficient in an enzyme called g6pd (glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase) that causes in abdomen or back pain, fatigue, dark urine, pallor, or yellow skin and eyes

Before taking NITROBEST TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)
Have anaemia (a decrease in red blood cells that causes pale skin, weakness and breathlessness)
Are suffering from any illness causing severe weakness
Lack of vitamin B (especially that results in fatigue, mouth sores, diarrhoea, and depression)
Have abnormal electrolyte levels in your blood

introduction:
Introduction About RIFAXIGRESS 400MG TABLET

RIFAXIGRESS 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAXIGRESS 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFAXIGRESS 400MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAXIGRESS 400MG TABLET Works

RIFAXIGRESS 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE.

DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.

mechanismOfAction:
How DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE Works

DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.

Take DALACIN C 300MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Lizomac 600mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET

LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)

Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LIZOMAC 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Introduction About RCIFAX 200MG TABLET

RCIFAX 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RCIFAX 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How RCIFAX 200MG TABLET Works

RCIFAX 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

How NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE Works

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

name: Linox 600mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LINOX 600MG TABLET

LINOX 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINOX 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINOX 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINOX 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINOX 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINOX 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINOX 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How LINOX 600MG TABLET Works

LINOX 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

Take LINOX 600MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINOX 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About LYNX 500MG CAPSULE

LYNX 500MG CAPSULE contains Lincomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Lincosamides. LYNX 500MG CAPSULE is used to manage the infections caused by susceptible strains of gram-positive bacteria (such as streptococci, pneumococci, staphylococci), and/or susceptible strains of anaerobic bacteria in affected individuals.

LYNX 500MG CAPSULE is also used to manage upper respiratory infections (including tonsillitis, pharyngitis, otitis media, sinusitis, scarlet fever), lower respiratory infections (including acute & chronic bronchitis, pneumonia), and skin & soft tissue infections.

LYNX 500MG CAPSULE is also indicated for use to manage bone & joint infections (including osteomyelitis, septic arthritis), septicaemia (life threatening complication of an infection), endocarditis (inflammation of heart valve), and bacillary dysentery.

LYNX 500MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to lincomycin, and/or clindamycin. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from meningitis (inflammation of membranes surrounding brain and spinal cord).

Before taking LYNX 500MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have diarrhoea, liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function), and/or kidney problems (such as severe kidney impairment).

LYNX 500MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

LYNX 500MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in children and adolescents (aged above 1 month to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking LYNX 500MG CAPSULE are diarrhoea, nausea, and/or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ZIMIGUT 400MG TABLET

ZIMIGUT 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking ZIMIGUT 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ZIMIGUT 400MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How ZIMIGUT 400MG TABLET Works

ZIMIGUT 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Flagyl 200mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About FLAGYL 200MG TABLET

FLAGYL 200MG TABLET is used in the management of various bacterial and parasitic infections such as bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection), trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections, blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area infections, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It helps to manage an infection after surgery.

You can take FLAGYL 200MG TABLET at any time of the day after food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Your symptoms may get better after a short time but do not stop taking it until you have finished a full course of treatment, even if you feel well. If you stop taking it early, some bacteria may survive, and the infection may come back. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FLAGYL 200MG TABLET and for a few days after stopping it. Otherwise, you may get unpleasant side effects like nausea, vomiting, and stomach pain.

Before taking FLAGYL 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. FLAGYL 200MG TABLET is used in a high dose or for a prolonged time increases the risk of side effects such as nerve damage. Take it only as prescribed by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking FLAGYL 200MG TABLET are headache, lack of appetite, nausea, dryness in mouth, metallic taste in mouth, stomach cramps and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you. You can try using sugarless candies or lozenges to overcome any dryness or metallic taste in the mouth.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLAGYL 200MG TABLET

FLAGYL 200MG TABLET is used to manage the following infection conditions:

Bacterial infections
Parasitic infections
Benefits of FLAGYL 200MG TABLET:

1. Management of Bacterial infections:

FLAGYL 200MG TABLET is a versatile antibiotic medicine that can be used to manage many different infections caused by bacteria. These include manage infections of the blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It can also be used to manage bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection).

2. Management of Parasitic infections:

FLAGYL 200MG TABLET is an antibiotic medicine that helps many parasitic infections such as trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections and amoebic dysentery. It works by stopping the growth of parasites causing the infection. This medicine usually makes you feel better quite quickly. However, you should continue taking it as long as it is prescribed even when you feel better, to make sure that all parasites are killed and do not become resistant.
mechanismOfAction:
How FLAGYL 200MG TABLET Works

FLAGYL 200MG TABLET contains a medicine called Metronidazole which is an antiprotozoal drug that kills bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. As a result, it kills the infection-causing germs and controls their future growth and multiplication, reducing the severity of the infection.
usageInstructions: Take FLAGYL 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow FLAGYL 200MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken after food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to infection may come back.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not consume alcohol during the course of treatment and for at least 48 hours after finishing the medication.
Inform Your Doctor if you have or had conditions such as kidney, liver and other neurological disorders like seizures or peripheral neuropathy

introduction:
Introduction About NIFTAS 50MG TABLET

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NIFTAS 50MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
usesDetails:
Uses Of NIFTAS 50MG TABLET
Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
mechanismOfAction:
How NIFTAS 50MG TABLET Works

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.
usageDetails:
How to use NIFTAS 50MG TABLET

Take NIFTAS 50MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow NIFTAS 50MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

warnings.details: NIFTAS 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use during labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby. It can be used with caution in pregnant women or are planning to have a baby. However, consult your doctor before taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET.

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should be used with caution for breastfeeding women and should be avoided particularly for infant with known or suspected with erythrocyte enzyme deficiency (including G6PD deficiency) as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or drowsy after taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET because it might make you dizzier.

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney disease that severely affects the function of kidneys. It should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET.
NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET.
Do not take NIFTAS 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to nitrofurantoin.
NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET.

Others

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are suffering from a blood disorder called porphyria (build-up of certain chemicals related to red blood cell that affects skin and nerve function)
Are deficient in an enzyme called g6pd (glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase) that causes in abdomen or back pain, fatigue, dark urine, pallor or yellow skin and eyes

Before taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)
Have anaemia (a decrease in red blood cells that causes pale skin, weakness and breathlessness)
Are suffering from any illness causing severe weakness
Lack of vitamin B (especially that results in fatigue, mouth sores, diarrhoea and depression)
Have abnormal electrolyte levels in your blood

Use in Pediatrics:

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (under 6 years of age) and infants above 3 months of age. It is not recommended for infants below three months of age. However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

NIFTAS 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking NIFTAS 50MG TABLET.

name: Ornida Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ORNIDA TABLET

ORNIDA TABLET contains Ornidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage infections that are caused by anaerobic bacteria (bacteria that do not use oxygen) or amoeba (single-celled parasites). Infections include certain types of vaginal, urinary tract and intestinal infections or some specific infections in the body. It is also used as prophylaxis during surgery to manage these types of infections.

Before taking ORNIDA TABLET, inform your doctor if you have epilepsy, multiple sclerosis (disease which affects the central nervous system), liver disease or if you are undergoing hemodialysis. Your doctor might advise you to take certain blood tests prior to management with ORNIDA TABLET to understand the existing condition and to safely use this medicine.

ORNIDA TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor and it should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. ORNIDA TABLET can be used in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s body weight and type of the infection. 

While taking this medicine you may experience side effects such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dry mouth and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage certain types of vaginal, urinary tract and intestinal infections or other specific infections in the body
Used as prophylaxis during surgery (particularly involving the colon and in gynaecological operations)

mechanismOfAction:
How ORNIDA TABLET Works

ORNIDA TABLET contains ornidazole which is an antiprotozoal agent that kills parasites and bacteria (that lives in the absence of oxygen) by generating harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria, thus helps to manage certain types of infections.

Take ORNIDA TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Avoid taking this medicine on empty stomach. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ORNIDA TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Amicline Plus Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About AMICLINE PLUS TABLET

AMICLINE PLUS TABLET is a combination of Ornidazole and Diloxanide which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics and Anti-protozoal agents respectively. It is used in the management of intestinal and extraintestinal amoebiasis (parasitic infection of the intestines caused by the amoeba Entamoeba histolytica). It is also used to manage diarrhea (amoebic etiology) and giardiasis (diarrheal infection of small intestine caused by Giardia lamblia).

Your doctor might want you to make certain lifestyle changes such as maintaining good hygiene, eating a healthy diet and drinking plenty of fluids.

Do not consume alcohol while taking AMICLINE PLUS TABLET. Consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.

Before taking AMICLINE PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart disease, epilepsy or multiple sclerosis (affecting brain).

AMICLINE PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age.

AMICLINE PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking AMICLINE PLUS TABLET are nausea, vomiting, dizziness, abdominal cramp, loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

Uses Of AMICLINE PLUS TABLET

Diarrhea

Extra-intestinal amoebiasis

How AMICLINE PLUS TABLET Works

AMICLINE PLUS TABLET is a combination of Ornidazole and Diloxanide. Ornidazole belongs to antibiotics which works against bacteria and other microorganisms that cause infections by damaging the DNA. Diloxanide belongs to amoebicide which works inside the large intestine to destroy the infection causing amoeba (parasites).
usageDetails:

Take AMICLINE PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAXIGRESS 550MG TABLET Works

RIFAXIGRESS 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.
