name: LNZ Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LNZ TABLET

LNZ TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LNZ TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LNZ TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LNZ TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LNZ TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LNZ TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LNZ TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of LNZ TABLET

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)
Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
Blood infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LNZ TABLET Works

LNZ TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LNZ TABLET

Take LNZ TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LNZ TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LNZ TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LNZ TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LNZ TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LNZ TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LNZ TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

RIFAXIGYL 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection
Do not stop taking the medicine without consulting your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy

introduction:
Introduction About ORNITAG 500MG TABLET

ORNITAG 500MG TABLET contains Ornidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage infections that are caused by anaerobic bacteria (bacteria that do not use oxygen) or amoeba (single-celled parasites). Infections include certain types of vaginal, urinary tract and intestinal infections or some specific infections in the body. It is also used as prophylaxis during surgery to manage these types of infections.

Before taking ORNITAG 500MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have epilepsy, multiple sclerosis (disease which affects the central nervous system), liver disease or if you are undergoing hemodialysis. Your doctor might advise you to take certain blood tests prior to management with ORNITAG 500MG TABLET to understand the existing condition and to safely use this medicine.

ORNITAG 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor and it should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. ORNITAG 500MG TABLET can be used in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s body weight and type of the infection. 

While taking this medicine you may experience side effects such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dry mouth and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage certain types of vaginal, urinary tract and intestinal infections or other specific infections in the body
Used as prophylaxis during surgery (particularly involving the colon and in gynaecological operations)

How ORNITAG 500MG TABLET Works

ORNITAG 500MG TABLET contains ornidazole which is an antiprotozoal agent that kills parasites and bacteria (that lives in the absence of oxygen) by generating harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria, thus helps to manage certain types of infections.

name: Camyda 300mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE

CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE.

CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE
Manage severe bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE Works

CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE

Take CAMYDA 300MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Lexilid 100mg Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP

LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia) and some bacterial infections in or under the skin (complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections) caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or stomach pain.

Before taking LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anaemia, history of seizures, diarrhoea, adrenal glands tumour (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome and if you are prone to get infections.

During management with LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP for more than 28 days.

LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, stomach pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Some bacterial infections in or under the skin (complicated and uncomplicated)

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)

mechanismOfAction:
How LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP Works

LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP

Take LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP as advised by your physician. Add provided sterile water slowly in the bottle containing dry powder and allow it to dissolve completely. Make up the volume up to the mark in the bottle. Use a measuring cup or a spoon to properly measure the dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP unless your doctor advises you to stop.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or problems with your vision after taking LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP.

Alcohol

Kidney

LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking LEXILID 100MG DRY SYRUP.

introduction:
Introduction About REXIGUT 550 TABLET

REXIGUT 550 TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking REXIGUT 550 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of REXIGUT 550 TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How REXIGUT 550 TABLET Works

REXIGUT 550 TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Infuran NF 100mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET

INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
usesDetails:
Uses Of INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET
Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
mechanismOfAction:
How INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET Works

INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.
usageDetails:
How to use INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET

Take INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. INFURAN NF 100MG TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

Others

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)
Have anaemia (a decrease in red blood cells that causes pale skin, weakness and breathlessness)
Are suffering from any illness causing severe weakness
Lack of vitamin B (especially that results in fatigue, mouth sores, diarrhoea, and depression)
Have abnormal electrolyte levels in your blood

Signs of autoimmune hepatitis (jaundice, fatigue, abdominal pain, joint pain and swelling)

name: Linid Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About LINID TABLET

LINID TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINID TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINID TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINID TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINID TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINID TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINID TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of LINID TABLET

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)
Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
Blood infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LINID TABLET Works

LINID TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LINID TABLET

Take LINID TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LINID TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LINID TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINID TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LINID TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINID TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LINID TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About MONUROL SACHET

MONUROL SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

MONUROL SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

MONUROL SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. MONUROL SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How MONUROL SACHET Works

MONUROL SACHET works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.
usageDetails:
How to use MONUROL SACHET

Take MONUROL SACHET as advised by your physician. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About XONIFT 100MG TABLET

XONIFT 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. XONIFT 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

XONIFT 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

XONIFT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. XONIFT 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking XONIFT 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

Introduction About DIRIFA 200MG TABLET

DIRIFA 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking DIRIFA 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How DIRIFA 200MG TABLET Works

DIRIFA 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

Do not stop taking the medicine without consulting your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy

name: FOSFOCIN Sachet 8gm
introduction:
Introduction About FOSFOCIN SACHET

FOSFOCIN SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

FOSFOCIN SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

FOSFOCIN SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. FOSFOCIN SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How FOSFOCIN SACHET Works

FOSFOCIN SACHET works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

Take FOSFOCIN SACHET as advised by your physician. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Megazolid 600mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET

MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)
Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
Blood infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET Works

MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET

Take MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEGAZOLID 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About GIFAXIN 400MG TABLET

GIFAXIN 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking GIFAXIN 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How GIFAXIN 400MG TABLET Works

GIFAXIN 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Metrogyl Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About METROGYL SUSPENSION

METROGYL SUSPENSION is used to manage various bacterial and parasitic infections in the body, such as amoebiasis, giardiasis (parasitic infection causing severe diarrhea with stomach cramps), trichomonas vaginitis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), infections of the blood, brain, lungs, bones, stomach (Ex. H. pylori infection), pelvis, urinary tract, genital tract (vaginal infections), and gums and teeth (Ex. gingivitis or other dental infections). It contains Metronidazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoal drugs, which helps manage infections effectively.

It can also be used in the management of infected leg ulcers or pressure sores and in the management of post-surgical infections and infections following childbirth. METROGYL SUSPENSION is suitable for use both in adults and in children, including full-term newborns, toddlers (aged 1 year or older), and older children (aged 10 years or older).

Take METROGYL SUSPENSION during or just after meals. It is important to take the full course of the therapy to achieve better control over the infection. Failure or skipping doses in between the therapies may not result in adequate infection control. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking METROGYL SUSPENSION, as it could increase the risk of dizziness and drowsiness.

Before taking METROGYL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if you have any problems with your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems with your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking METROGYL SUSPENSION are lack of appetite, nausea, metallic taste in the mouth, and stomach cramps. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How METROGYL SUSPENSION Works

METROGYL SUSPENSION is an antiprotozoal agent with antibacterial properties. It works by killing the bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. This destroys the infection-causing germs within the body and manages their further growth and multiplication, which therefore reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use METROGYL SUSPENSION

Take METROGYL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required amount of medicine in the measuring cup provided with the pack and consume the medicine immediately. It must be taken during or just after meals.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight, and severity of the infection. Do not stop therapy or skip doses in between the therapy to achieve better control over infection.

name: Novefos Sachet Powder 8Gm
introduction:
Introduction About NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER

NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER
Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
mechanismOfAction:
How NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER Works

NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.
usageDetails:
How to use NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER

Take NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER as advised by your physician. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Inflammation, irritation and itching due to infection of the female genital organs
Anaphylactic shock symptoms such as the sudden onset of rash, itching or hives on the skin and or shortness of breath, wheezing or trouble breathing
Serious allergic reaction symptoms such as swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat with breathing difficulties (angioedema)
Large intestine (pseudomembranous colitis) infection symptoms such as severe abdominal cramps, bloody stools and /or fever

Serious allergic reaction symptoms such as swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat with breathing difficulties (angioedema)

NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER should not be used by breastfeeding women because it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or fatigued after taking NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER.

NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems, undergoing haemodialysis (a procedure used to clean the blood by removing waste and extra fluids when the kidneys are not functioning), etc. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.
NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NOVEFOS SACHET POWDER if you are allergic to Fosfomycin or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Have persistent infections of the bladder
Have experienced the symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics
Have an intolerance to some sugars

name: Megazolid 100 Oral Suspension 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP

MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia) and some bacterial infections in or under the skin (complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections) caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or stomach pain.

Before taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anaemia, history of seizures, diarrhoea, adrenal glands tumour (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome and if you are prone to get infections.

During management with MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP for more than 28 days.

MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, stomach pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Some bacterial infections in or under the skin (complicated and uncomplicated)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)
Some bacterial infections in or under the skin (complicated and uncomplicated)
Vancomycin-resistant Enterococcus faecium infections
mechanismOfAction:
How MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP Works

MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP

Take MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP as advised by your physician. Add provided sterile water slowly in the bottle containing dry powder and allow it to dissolve completely. Make up the volume up to the mark in the bottle. Use a measuring cup or a spoon to properly measure the dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP unless your doctor advises you to stop.
sideEffects: Diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, localized or general stomach pain, constipation, indigestion
Inflammation of the vagina or genital area (women)
Severe skin disorder and allergic reactions (sign includes swelling particularly around the face and neck, wheezing, difficulty breathing, red sore skin and flaking, rash and itching)
Vision problems (like blurred vision, changes in colour vision, difficulty in seeing detail or a restricted field of vision)
Severe diarrhoea with blood or mucus (it may develop into complications which are life-threatening)
Repeated nausea or vomiting, abdominal pain or rapid breathing
Changes in the numbers of certain blood cells which may lead to infection (signs of infection include fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers and tiredness)

Transient ischaemic attacks (temporary disturbance of the flow of blood to the brain causing short-term symptoms such as loss of vision, leg and arm weakness, slurring of speech and loss of consciousness)
New or worsening myelosuppression (fewer blood cells due to bone marrow suppression)
Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH) causing confusion, sleepiness, generalized weakness, respiratory failure

Increased sweating
Kidney failure
Abdominal bloating
Increased or decreased heart rate
Weakness, sensory changes
Inflammation of the vagina or genital area (women)
Rare
Superficial tooth discolouration

Stop taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe skin disorder and allergic reactions (sign includes swelling particularly around the face and neck, wheezing, difficulty breathing, red sore skin and flaking, rash and itching)
Vision problems (like blurred vision, changes in colour vision, difficulty in seeing detail or a restricted field of vision)
Severe diarrhoea with blood or mucus (it may develop into complications which are life-threatening)
Repeated nausea or vomiting, abdominal pain or rapid breathing
Fits or seizures
Unexplained bleeding or bruising
Changes in the numbers of certain blood cells which may lead to infection (signs of infection include fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers and tiredness)
Inflammation of the pancreas
Convulsions
Transient ischaemic attacks (temporary disturbance of the flow of blood to the brain causing short-term symptoms such as loss of vision, leg and arm weakness, slurring of speech and loss of consciousness)
Ringing in the ears (tinnitus)
New or worsening myelosuppression (fewer blood cells due to bone marrow suppression)
Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH) causing confusion, sleepiness, generalized weakness, respiratory failure

MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP.

Before taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you:

Have an overactive thyroid
Have adrenal glands tumour (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome (tumours of the hormone system causing diarrhoea, flushing of the skin, wheezing)
Have mental disorders such as manic depression, schizoaffective disorder, mental confusion or other mental problems
Bruise and bleed easily
Are anaemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to get infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhoea
Have phenylketonuria (a rare genetic disorder that causes certain amino acids to build up in the body)

Use in pediatrics:

MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition which affects the blood, bone marrow or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:  

Medicines used to manage cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)    

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts or soya bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP as it may react with a substance called tyramine which is naturally present in some foods and cause an increase in blood pressure.

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEGAZOLID DRY SYRUP, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:
Introduction About RIFABIZ 400MG TABLET

RIFABIZ 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFABIZ 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:

Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFABIZ 400MG TABLET Works

RIFABIZ 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Vanking 500mg Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About VANKING 500MG INJECTION

VANKING 500MG INJECTION contains Vancomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Glycopeptide antibiotics. It is used for the management of serious infections caused by susceptible strains of methicillin-resistant (beta-lactam-resistant) staphylococci bacteria.

VANKING 500MG INJECTION is used for the management of endocarditis (infection to the inner lining of heart with symptoms of fever, chills, difficulty in breathing etc) as well as is used for the management of hospital acquired pneumonia, infections of skin and tissues below skin, bone and joints (involves osteomyelitis, arthritis, spinal infections etc with symptoms of pain, fever, chills, swelling in joints etc).

Also, it is used to manage central nervous system infection (meningitis, abscess, brain enlargement with symptoms of headache, fever, mood changes) and blood caused by bacteria. Symptoms of these infections are usually recurrent fever and chills, headache and difficulty in breathing. VANKING 500MG INJECTION is also used to manage infections in patients who are allergic to the medicines containing penicillin and cephalosporins.

Before receiving VANKING 500MG INJECTION, your doctor will do few blood tests to determine the exact cause of infection. It should be used only to manage infections that are proven or strongly suspected to be caused by susceptible bacteria.

VANKING 500MG INJECTION is not recommended in patients who have hypersensitivity to vancomycin.

Before receiving VANKING 500MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have kidney diseases or hearing diseases. VANKING 500MG INJECTION should be used in caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The common side effects of receiving VANKING 500MG INJECTION include difficulty in breathing, fall in blood pressure, redness of body and face, fever, etc. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen with time.

warnings.details: VANKING 500MG INJECTION should be given during pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
VANKING 500MG INJECTION should be given during breast-feeding only if considered clearly necessary as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
VANKING 500MG INJECTION has no or negligible effect on your ability to drive and use machines.
VANKING 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with kidney disorder. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not receive VANKING 500MG INJECTION if you are allergic to vancomycin or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before receiving VANKING 500MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have hearing disorder
Blood disorders
Sensitive to any food or medicine

Use in pediatrics:

VANKING 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in with particular care in premature infants and young infants, because their kidneys are not fully developed and they may accumulate VANKING 500MG INJECTION in the blood. This age group may need blood tests for controlling vancomycin levels in blood. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

VANKING 500MG INJECTION is used with caution in elderly people with kidney diseases, hearing diseases and those who are undergoing dialysis. Your doctor will do blood test and hearing test during management with VANKING 500MG INJECTION. Lower dose of VANKING 500MG INJECTION is advised for elder people. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

name: ELOSONE Nasal Spray 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY

ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY contains Mometasone which belongs to the group of medicines called Corticosteroids. ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY is used to manage the symptoms of hay fever (seasonal allergic rhinitis) and perennial rhinitis in adults and children aged 2 and older. This medicine is also used to manage nasal polyps in adults aged 18 and over.

Hay Fever is an allergic reaction which occurs due to breathing in pollen from trees, grasses, weeds, molds and fungal spores generally characterized by blocked or runny nose, sneezing and coughing.

Perennial rhinitis is an inflammatory condition which occurs due to sensitivity to a variety of things such as house dust mite, animal hair, feathers and certain foods characterized by symptoms such as blocked nose, sneezing, itching that might occur for an hour or more on most days throughout the year.

Nasal polyps are small growths on the lining of the nose which usually affects both nostrils generally characterized by runny nose, and stuffiness.

Avoid using ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY, if you are allergic to Mometasone, and or have an unmanageed infection in your nose such as herpes, recent injury or operation on your nose.

Before using ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY, inform your doctor if you have kidney, or liver disease. ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY should be used in pregnant women only if it is clearly necessary. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding women.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor before using ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY.

The most common side effects of using ELOSONE NASAL SPRAY are headache, sneezing, nose bleeds, sore nose or throat, ulcers in the nose and or respiratory tract infection. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms gets worsen.

In nasal polyps, it relieves the blocked feeling in the nose by reducing the inflammation in the nose thereby enabling easy breathing through the nose.

introduction:
Introduction About CLINSOL CAPSULE

CLINSOL CAPSULE contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking CLINSOL CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. CLINSOL CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking CLINSOL CAPSULE.

CLINSOL CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking CLINSOL CAPSULE are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINSOL CAPSULE
Manage severe bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINSOL CAPSULE Works

CLINSOL CAPSULE acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINSOL CAPSULE

Take CLINSOL CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Rexigut 400mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About REXIGUT 400MG TABLET

REXIGUT 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking REXIGUT 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of REXIGUT 400MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How REXIGUT 400MG TABLET Works

REXIGUT 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About LINOLET 600MG TABLET

LINOLET 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINOLET 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINOLET 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINOLET 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINOLET 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINOLET 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINOLET 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How LINOLET 600MG TABLET Works

LINOLET 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LINOLET 600MG TABLET

Take LINOLET 600MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LINOLET 600MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LINOLET 600MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINOLET 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LINOLET 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINOLET 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LINOLET 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About MYFOS SACHET

MYFOS SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

MYFOS SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

MYFOS SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. MYFOS SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How MYFOS SACHET Works

MYFOS SACHET works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

introduction:
Introduction About REZFURAN 100MG TABLET

REZFURAN 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. REZFURAN 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

REZFURAN 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

REZFURAN 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. REZFURAN 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking REZFURAN 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

REZFURAN 100MG TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. REZFURAN 100MG TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET

ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET is used in the management of various bacterial and parasitic infections such as bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection), trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections, blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area infections, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It helps to manage an infection after surgery.

You can take ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET at any time of the day after food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Your symptoms may get better after a short time but do not stop taking it until you have finished a full course of treatment, even if you feel well. If you stop taking it early, some bacteria may survive, and the infection may come back. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET and for a few days after stopping it. Otherwise, you may get unpleasant side effects like nausea, vomiting, and stomach pain.

Before taking ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET is used in a high dose or for a prolonged time increases the risk of side effects such as nerve damage. Take it only as prescribed by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET are headache, lack of appetite, nausea, dryness in mouth, metallic taste in mouth, stomach cramps and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you. You can try using sugarless candies or lozenges to overcome any dryness or metallic taste in the mouth.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET

ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET is used to manage the following infection conditions:

Bacterial infections
Parasitic infections
Benefits of ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET:

1. Management of Bacterial infections:

ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET is a versatile antibiotic medicine that can be used to manage many different infections caused by bacteria. These include manage infections of the blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It can also be used to manage bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection).

2. Management of Parasitic infections:

ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET is an antibiotic medicine that helps many parasitic infections such as trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections and amoebic dysentery. It works by stopping the growth of parasites causing the infection. This medicine usually makes you feel better quite quickly. However, you should continue taking it as long as it is prescribed even when you feel better, to make sure that all parasites are killed and do not become resistant.
mechanismOfAction:
How ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET Works

ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET contains a medicine called Metronidazole which is an antiprotozoal drug that kills bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. As a result, it kills the infection-causing germs and controls their future growth and multiplication, reducing the severity of the infection.
usageInstructions: Take ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken after food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to infection may come back.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not consume alcohol during the course of treatment and for at least 48 hours after finishing the medication.
Inform Your Doctor if you have or had conditions such as kidney, liver and other neurological disorders like seizures or peripheral neuropathy

warnings.details: ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET is generally considered safe to use during pregnancy. While there are limited human studies, animal research has shown low or no adverse effects to the developing baby. Please consult with your doctor for further guidance.
ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not suitable for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness, hallucination, or confusion while taking this medicine.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET as it may cause unpleasant side effects such as nausea and vomiting, stomach pain, hot flashes, irregular heartbeat, thirst, and headache.
ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (including dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Dose adjustment of ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET may be needed. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Metronidazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking ARISTOGYL 400MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have any diseases affecting your nervous system
Have Cockayne syndrome (a rare genetic disorder characterized by short stature, low intellectual ability and neurological problems)
Have blood dyscrasias (a blood condition affecting blood components, bone marrow, lymph and blood vessels)
Have a history of seizures

introduction:
Introduction About RIFAREX 550MG TABLET

RIFAREX 550MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAREX 550MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:

Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAREX 550MG TABLET Works

RIFAREX 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

How SIBOFIX 550MG TABLET Works

SIBOFIX 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About VOXYLID 600MG TABLET

VOXYLID 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking VOXYLID 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with VOXYLID 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take VOXYLID 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

VOXYLID 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. VOXYLID 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking VOXYLID 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Complicated skin and soft tissue infections

mechanismOfAction:
How VOXYLID 600MG TABLET Works

VOXYLID 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse VOXYLID 600MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take VOXYLID 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

VOXYLID 600MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition that affects the blood, bone marrow, or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking VOXYLID 600MG TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking VOXYLID 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking VOXYLID 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of VOXYLID 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.
