introduction:
Introduction About UTICHEK SR 100MG TABLET

UTICHEK SR 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. UTICHEK SR 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

UTICHEK SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

UTICHEK SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. UTICHEK SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking UTICHEK SR 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

name: VANKING 1000 Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About VANKING 1000 INJECTION

VANKING 1000 INJECTION is used for the management of serious infections caused by susceptible strains of methicillin-resistant (beta-lactam-resistant) staphylococci bacteria. It is used for the management of endocarditis as well as is used for the management of hospital acquired pneumonia, infections of skin and tissues below skin, bone and joints (involves osteomyelitis, arthritis, spinal infections etc with symptoms of pain, fever, chills, swelling in joints). Also, it is used to manage central nervous system infection (meningitis, abscess, brain enlargement with symptoms of headache, fever, mood changes) and blood caused by bacteria. VANKING 1000 INJECTION is also used to manage infections in patients who are allergic to the medicines containing penicillin and cephalosporins. It contains Vancomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Glycopeptide antibiotics that works by managing cell wall formation of infection causing bacteria by blocking the enzymes responsible for it.

Before receiving VANKING 1000 INJECTION, your doctor will do few blood tests to determine the exact cause of infection. It should be used only to manage infections that are proven or strongly suspected to be caused by susceptible bacteria. VANKING 1000 INJECTION is not recommended in patients who have hypersensitivity to vancomycin.

Before receiving VANKING 1000 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have kidney diseases or hearing diseases. VANKING 1000 INJECTION should be used in caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving it. The common side effects of receiving VANKING 1000 INJECTION include difficulty in breathing, fall in blood pressure, redness of body and face, fever. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen with time.

Manage infections of central nervous system (such as meningitis (infection of brain), abscess, brain enlargement)

name: Ocupol Eye Ear Drop 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP

OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP is a combination of Chloramphenicol and Polymyxin B which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in adults to manage bacterial infections of the eyes and ear canal. Eye infection is characterized by warmth, redness, swelling and pain. Ear infection can show symptoms like ear pain, fever, irritability, rubbing or tugging ear or difficulty sleeping.

During course of the management your doctor might regularly examine your eye and ear to avoid any untoward side effects. The safety and effectiveness of OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP have not been established in children.

Before using OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP, inform your doctor if you have a family history of blood disorders or if you wear contact lenses. OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP is not recommended for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of using OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP are temporary burning, stinging, irritation, itching, redness, blurry eyesight, light sensitivity or allergic reaction. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage bacterial infections of the eyes and ear canal
usesDetails:
Uses Of OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP
Manage bacterial infections of the eyes and ear canal
mechanismOfAction:
How OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP Works

OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP manages infection, where chloramphenicol binds to the 50S ribosomal subunit, managing the formation of bacterial protein and polymyxin B interacts with certain molecules of the outer membrane of infecting bacteria, changing membrane permeability and killing the cell.
usageDetails:
How to use OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP

Use OCUPOL EYE EAR DROP as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Do not touch the tip of the dropper on any surface. Squeeze the dropper gently, then dispense the medication inside the lower eyelid or ear. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, disease condition and body weight.

Introduction About FENEM ER 300MG TABLET

FENEM ER 300MG TABLET contains Faropenem, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of respiratory tract infections, ear, nose, and throat infections, urinary tract infections, skin and skin structure infections, and gynaecological infections.

FENEM ER 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with rare hereditary problems like galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, and glucose galactose malabsorption. Contact your doctor before taking.

FENEM ER 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver or kidney diseases, history of hypersensitivity or anaphylactic reactions to penicillin, cephem, or carbapenems, family history of atopy, poor oral intake or poor general health or vitamin K deficiency, diarrhea, and loose bowel movement. Contact your doctor before taking.

FENEM ER 300MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary. Contact your doctor before taking.

FENEM ER 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

FENEM ER 300MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

FENEM ER 300MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of taking FENEM ER 300MG TABLET are vomiting, stomach pain, diarrhea and lack of appetite, gastritis, constipation, dizziness, drowsiness, edema, muscle pain, and lethargy. Contact your physician if any of the symptoms worsen.

name: Lexilid Tablet 4'S
introduction:
Introduction About LEXILID TABLET

LEXILID TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LEXILID TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LEXILID TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LEXILID TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LEXILID TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LEXILID TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LEXILID TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of LEXILID TABLET

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)
Complicated skin and soft tissue infections
Blood infections
mechanismOfAction:
How LEXILID TABLET Works

LEXILID TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LEXILID TABLET

Take LEXILID TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LEXILID TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LEXILID TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LEXILID TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.
sideEffects: Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, localized or general stomach pain, constipation, indigestion
Inflammation of the vagina or genital area (women)

Severe skin disorder and allergic reactions (signs include swelling, particularly around the face and neck, wheezing, difficulty breathing, raised purple rash due to inflammation of blood vessels, red sore skin and flaking, rash, and itching)
Vision problems (like blurred vision, changes in color vision, difficulty in seeing detail, or restricted field of vision)
Severe diarrhea with blood or mucus (it may develop into complications that are life-threatening)
Repeated nausea or vomiting, abdominal pain, or rapid breathing
Fits or seizures or serotonin syndrome (signs include agitation, confusion, mental disturbance, rigidity, shaking, incoordination, seizure, rapid heart rate, and severe breathing problems)
Changes in the numbers of certain blood cells that may lead to infection (signs of infection include fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers, and tiredness)

Transient ischemic attacks (temporary disturbance of the flow of blood to the brain causing short-term symptoms such as loss of vision, leg and arm weakness, slurring of speech, and loss of consciousness)

Side Effects Of LEXILID TABLET
Common
Vaginal or oral thrush (fungal infection)
Headache, dizziness
Metallic taste in the mouth
Diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, localized or general stomach pain, constipation, indigestion
Difficulty in sleeping
Localized pain

Uncommon

Swollen, sore, or discoloured tongue
Dry mouth
Frequent urination
Chills
Feeling thirsty
Increased sweating
Kidney failure
Abdominal bloating
Increased or decreased heart rate
Weakness, sensory changes
Inflammation of the vagina or genital area (women)
Rare

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LEXILID TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)

Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LEXILID TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LEXILID TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET

FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET is used in the management of various bacterial and parasitic infections such as bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection), trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections, blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area infections, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It helps to manage an infection after surgery.

You can take FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET at any time of the day after food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Your symptoms may get better after a short time but do not stop taking it until you have finished a full course of treatment, even if you feel well. If you stop taking it early, some bacteria may survive, and the infection may come back. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET and for a few days after stopping it. Otherwise, you may get unpleasant side effects like nausea, vomiting, and stomach pain.

Before taking FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET is used in a high dose or for a prolonged time increases the risk of side effects such as nerve damage. Take it only as prescribed by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET are headache, lack of appetite, nausea, dryness in mouth, metallic taste in mouth, stomach cramps and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you. You can try using sugarless candies or lozenges to overcome any dryness or metallic taste in the mouth.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET

FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET is used to manage the following infection conditions:

Bacterial infections
Parasitic infections
Benefits of FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET:

1. Management of Bacterial infections:

FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET is a versatile antibiotic medicine that can be used to manage many different infections caused by bacteria. These include manage infections of the blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It can also be used to manage bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection).

2. Management of Parasitic infections:

FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET is an antibiotic medicine that helps many parasitic infections such as trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections and amoebic dysentery. It works by stopping the growth of parasites causing the infection. This medicine usually makes you feel better quite quickly. However, you should continue taking it as long as it is prescribed even when you feel better, to make sure that all parasites are killed and do not become resistant.
mechanismOfAction:
How FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET Works

FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET contains a medicine called Metronidazole which is an antiprotozoal drug that kills bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. As a result, it kills the infection-causing germs and controls their future growth and multiplication, reducing the severity of the infection.
usageInstructions: Take FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow FLAGYL ER 600 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken after food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to infection may come back.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not consume alcohol during the course of treatment and for at least 48 hours after finishing the medication.
Inform Your Doctor if you have or had conditions such as kidney, liver and other neurological disorders like seizures or peripheral neuropathy

Introduction About TORFIX 550MG TABLET

TORFIX 550MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking TORFIX 550MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TORFIX 550MG TABLET Works

TORFIX 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About NIFNEXT SR 100MG TABLET

NIFNEXT SR 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NIFNEXT SR 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NIFNEXT SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NIFNEXT SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NIFNEXT SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NIFNEXT SR 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

name: TURBO 600mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TURBO 600MG TABLET

TURBO 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking TURBO 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with TURBO 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take TURBO 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

TURBO 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TURBO 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking TURBO 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How TURBO 600MG TABLET Works

TURBO 600MG TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use TURBO 600MG TABLET

Take TURBO 600MG TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow TURBO 600MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse TURBO 600MG TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take TURBO 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TURBO 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking TURBO 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TURBO 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

name: Oflacin Eye/Ear Drops 5ml
introduction:
Introduction About OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS

OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS is used in the management of eye and ear bacterial infections such as conjunctivitis, keratoconjunctivitis, otitis media, etc. It contains a medicine called ofloxacin which is an antibacterial agent. It stops bacteria from multiplying by disrupting their ability to create and repair DNA, which is crucial for their growth.

Use OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS exactly as instructed by your physician. Misuse or overuse of this medicine may lead to unwanted side effects. If there is no improvement in your condition even after using this medicine for 7 days, consult your doctor for advice. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

Before using OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS inform your doctor if you have ulcers in the eyes. Consult your doctor before using OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of using OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS is eye discomfort or irritation. Consult your doctor if it troubles you.
uses: Management of bacterial eye and ear infections
usesDetails:
Uses Of OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS
Management of bacterial eye and ear infections
mechanismOfAction:
How OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS Works

OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS contains Ofloxacin which works by stopping bacteria from multiplying. It does this by interfering with the bacteria's ability to make and repair their DNA, which is essential for their growth and survival. By blocking the enzymes needed for this process, ofloxacin prevents the bacteria from reproducing, ultimately destroying them and clearing up the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS

Use OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS as advised by your physician. It is for topical use only.

For Eyes: Tilt your head slightly backwards and gently pull your lower eyelid. Instil few drops of this medicine into the eyes and close your eyes for 2 minutes. Repeat the same for the other eye if required. If you wear soft contact lenses, remove the lens before applying OFLACIN EYE/EAR DROPS and wait for at least 15 minutes before reinsertion.

For Ears: Gently instil few drops of this medicine into the ears. Repeat the same for the other ear if required.

Wash your hands before and after application. Do not touch the tip of the container with your eyes, eyelids, areas around your eyes, outer surface of the ears or fingers, to avoid contamination.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. If there is no improvement in your condition even after using this medicine for 7 days, consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About RIFAXIGYL 400MG TABLET

RIFAXIGYL 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAXIGYL 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:

Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAXIGYL 400MG TABLET Works

RIFAXIGYL 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Xylistin 1 Miu Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION

XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of serious bacterial infections when other antibiotics are not suitable. It is clinically effective in managing various infections caused by certain gram-negative bacteria, such as Aerobacter aerogenes, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

A bacterial infection can be defined as a proliferation of various harmful strains of bacteria in the body. They can affect any part(s) of the body, including the respiratory tract, urinary tract, eyes, ears, skin, soft tissue, or bones.

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before receiving XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. To avoid side effects, your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin and constantly monitor your kidney functions while receiving XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION. You must also inform your doctor if you have any inherited blood or muscle disorders before receiving XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION.

Do not take XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION if you are allergic to any of the ingredients present in it. XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if prescribed by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION are stomach upset, tingling sensation in the extremities, loss of sensation, fever, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION Works

XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.

XYLISTIN 1 MIU INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and severity of infection.

introduction:
Introduction About DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE

DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE.

DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE
Manage severe bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE Works

DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.

How to use DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE

Take DALACIN C 150MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Rcifax 550mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RCIFAX 550MG TABLET

RCIFAX 550MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RCIFAX 550MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RCIFAX 550MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RCIFAX 550MG TABLET Works

RCIFAX 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: NITROTAG SR 100mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET

NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
usesDetails:
Uses Of NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET
Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
mechanismOfAction:
How NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET Works

NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.
usageDetails:
How to use NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET

Take NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET because it might make you dizzier.

NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET.
Do not take NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET if you are allergic to nitrofurantoin.
NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET.

NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in children (under 6 years of age) and infants above 3 months of age. It is not recommended for infants below three months of age. However, consult your child’s doctor for advice.
NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET.

Others

NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are suffering from a blood disorder called porphyria (build-up of certain chemicals related to red blood cell that affects skin and nerve function)
Are deficient in an enzyme called g6pd (glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase) that causes in abdomen or back pain, fatigue, dark urine, pallor, or yellow skin and eyes

Before taking NITROTAG SR 100MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)
Have anaemia (a decrease in red blood cells that causes pale skin, weakness and breathlessness)
Are suffering from any illness causing severe weakness
Lack of vitamin B (especially that results in fatigue, mouth sores, diarrhoea, and depression)
Have abnormal electrolyte levels in your blood

name: VOXYLID Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About VOXYLID DRY SYRUP

VOXYLID DRY SYRUP contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia) and some bacterial infections in or under the skin (complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections) caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or stomach pain.

Before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anaemia, history of seizures, diarrhoea, adrenal glands tumour (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome and if you are prone to get infections.

During management with VOXYLID DRY SYRUP, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take VOXYLID DRY SYRUP for more than 28 days.

VOXYLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. VOXYLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation, stomach pain and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How VOXYLID DRY SYRUP Works

VOXYLID DRY SYRUP works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use VOXYLID DRY SYRUP

Take VOXYLID DRY SYRUP as advised by your physician. Add provided sterile water slowly in the bottle containing dry powder and allow it to dissolve completely. Make up the volume up to the mark in the bottle. Use a measuring cup or a spoon to properly measure the dose.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: VOXYLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.
VOXYLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and could affect the baby. Consult your doctor before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or problems with your vision after taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.
Avoid consumption of alcohol (especially draught beers and wine) while taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.
VOXYLID DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems especially if the patient is on dialysis. Consult your doctor before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.
VOXYLID DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.
Do not take VOXYLID DRY SYRUP if you are allergic to Linezolid or any other ingredients of this medicine.
VOXYLID DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.

Others

Before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you:

Have an overactive thyroid
Have adrenal glands tumour (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome (tumours of the hormone system causing diarrhoea, flushing of the skin, wheezing)
Have mental disorders such as manic depression, schizoaffective disorder, mental confusion or other mental problems
Bruise and bleed easily
Are anaemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to get infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhoea
Have phenylketonuria (a rare genetic disorder that causes certain amino acids to build up in the body)

Use in pediatrics:

VOXYLID DRY SYRUP is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

VOXYLID DRY SYRUP should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition which affects the blood, bone marrow or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:  

Medicines used to manage cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)    

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts or soya bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking VOXYLID DRY SYRUP as it may react with a substance called tyramine which is naturally present in some foods and cause an increase in blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of VOXYLID DRY SYRUP, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

name: Torfix 400mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TORFIX 400MG TABLET

TORFIX 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking TORFIX 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of TORFIX 400MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How TORFIX 400MG TABLET Works

TORFIX 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Merowin 500mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEROWIN 500MG INJECTION

MEROWIN 500MG INJECTION contains Meropenem which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections such as pneumonia (including community acquired pneumonia and nosocomial pneumonia), urinary tract infections, intra-abdominal infections, gynaecological infections such as endometritis and pelvic inflammatory disease, skin and skin structure infections, meningitis and septicaemia. It is also indicated for empiric management, for presumed infections in adult patients with febrile neutropenia, used as monotherapy or in combination with anti-viral or anti-fungal agents. MEROWIN 500MG INJECTION is also used in the management of neutropenic patients with fever that is suspected to be due to a bacterial infection and bacterial infection of the blood.

During the management, your doctor may do blood tests from time to time. MEROWIN 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems, kidney problems, and diarrhea. MEROWIN 500MG INJECTION is generally not recommended in patients with gastrointestinal problems and hypersensitivity reactions. Consult your doctor before receiving if you are pregnant or breastfeeding women.

MEROWIN 500MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children over 3 months old and in geriatric patients. The common side effects of MEROWIN 500MG INJECTION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, headache, skin rash, itchy skin, pain, and inflammation. Consult your doctor if the above symptom does not improve.

name: Vanlid 250mg Capsule 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About VANLID 250MG CAPSULE

VANLID 250MG CAPSULE contains Vancomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Glycopeptide antibiotics. It is used for the management of diarrhoea (loose or watery stools that occurs frequently than usual) caused by Clostridium difficile bacteria. It is also used for the management of Enterocolitis caused by staphylococcus aureus bacterium.

Enterocolitis is an inflammation of the digestive tract that affects inner part of the small intestine and colon (part of large intestine). Symptoms include loose stools, nausea, vomiting, stomach pain, fever, intestinal bleeding and tiredness.

Before taking VANLID 250MG CAPSULE, your doctor will do few blood tests to determine the exact organism which is responsible for infection. Your doctor will monitor your kidney function tests before initiating the management and during management with VANLID 250MG CAPSULE. It should be used only to manage infections that are proven or strongly suspected to be caused by susceptible bacteria.

VANLID 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to vancomycin. Before taking VANLID 250MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have kidney diseases, hearing problems, blood disorders or any digestive tract disorders (such as ulcerative colitis). VANLID 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution during pregnancy and breast-feeding only if clearly advised by the doctor.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients particularly with reduced renal function. The common side effects of taking VANLID 250MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, excess gas, fever, headache and tiredness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of VANLID 250MG CAPSULE

Used to manage:

Clostridium difficile-associated diarrhoea
Staphylococcal enterocolitis
mechanismOfAction:
How VANLID 250MG CAPSULE Works

VANLID 250MG CAPSULE is a glycopeptide antibiotic that works by blocking cell wall synthesis of disease-causing bacteria. This leads to management of bacterial growth in the body and helps to reduce the infection and its symptoms. In addition, vancomycin alters bacterial-cell-membrane permeability and RNA synthesis.
usageDetails:
How to use VANLID 250MG CAPSULE

Take VANLID 250MG CAPSULE exactly as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not chew or open the medicine contents. Do not stop taking VANLID 250MG CAPSULE without doctor’s advice even if you feel better. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

name: LIZOFORCE 600 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET

LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET Works

LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

How to use LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET

Take LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Bruise and bleed easily
Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections
Have a history of seizures

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LIZOFORCE 600 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract

Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
mechanismOfAction:
How NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE Works

NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.
usageDetails:
How to use NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE

Take NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. NIFTRAN 100MG CAPSULE should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

Have diabetes (high blood sugar)

introduction:
Introduction About RIFAREX 400MG TABLET

RIFAREX 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAREX 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFAREX 400MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAREX 400MG TABLET Works

RIFAREX 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION

WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in infants and in children to manage bacterial infections of the gut (stomach and intestines).

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before starting the therapy with WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if your child has any kidney problems. Your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin to your child and constantly monitor their kidney functions to avoid the risk of side effects. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any inherited blood or muscle disorders before starting the therapy with WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION.

Do not give WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION to your child if your child is allergic to any of its ingredients. The most common side effects of taking WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION are stomach upset, nausea, vomiting, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen in your child.

This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.

How to use WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION

Use WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Reconstitute the medicine with the sterile water given along with the package or with boiled, cooled water before administration. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture vigorously for at least 10-15 minutes until it forms a uniform mixture. Measure the medicine using the measuring cup given along with the package and administer it to your child.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, quantity (ml), and duration of therapy for your child depending upon their age, body weight, and severity of infection. Shake the medicine well before each use. Do not stop giving WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION to your child without consulting your doctor, even if they feel better after a few days of therapy. Continue to give WALAMYCIN DS SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration mentioned by your doctor to achieve maximum benefits.

Introduction About FAXICAD 550MG TABLET

FAXICAD 550MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking FAXICAD 550MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How FAXICAD 550MG TABLET Works

FAXICAD 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET

LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LINOSPAN 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

Introduction About LINID INFUSION

LINID INFUSION contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).    

Bacterial infections are caused by multiplication of specific harmful strain of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or stomach pain.

During management with LINID INFUSION, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you receive LINID INFUSION for more than 28 days. 

LINID INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINID INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of receiving LINID INFUSION are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, metallic taste in the mouth and indigestion. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

Have history of low blood sodium levels
Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhea

Use in pediatrics:

LINID INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice. 

Use in geriatrics:     

LINID INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (condition which affects the blood, bone marrow or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

Interactions

A.Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving LINID INFUSION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts or soya bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while receiving LINID INFUSION as it may react with a substance called tyramine which is naturally present in some foods and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

LINID INFUSION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms.

name: METROGYL 200 Tablet 20's
introduction:
Introduction About METROGYL 200 TABLET

METROGYL 200 TABLET is used in the management of various bacterial and parasitic infections such as bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection), trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections, blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area infections, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It helps to manage an infection after surgery.

You can take METROGYL 200 TABLET at any time of the day after food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Your symptoms may get better after a short time but do not stop taking it until you have finished a full course of treatment, even if you feel well. If you stop taking it early, some bacteria may survive, and the infection may come back. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking METROGYL 200 TABLET and for a few days after stopping it. Otherwise, you may get unpleasant side effects like nausea, vomiting, and stomach pain.

Before taking METROGYL 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. METROGYL 200 TABLET is used in a high dose or for a prolonged time increases the risk of side effects such as nerve damage. Take it only as prescribed by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking METROGYL 200 TABLET are headache, lack of appetite, nausea, dryness in mouth, metallic taste in mouth, stomach cramps and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you. You can try using sugarless candies or lozenges to overcome any dryness or metallic taste in the mouth.
usesDetails:
Uses Of METROGYL 200 TABLET

METROGYL 200 TABLET is used to manage the following infection conditions:

Bacterial infections
Parasitic infections
Benefits of METROGYL 200 TABLET:

1. Management of Bacterial infections:

METROGYL 200 TABLET is a versatile antibiotic medicine that can be used to manage many different infections caused by bacteria. These include manage infections of the blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It can also be used to manage bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection).

2. Management of Parasitic infections:

METROGYL 200 TABLET is an antibiotic medicine that helps many parasitic infections such as trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections and amoebic dysentery. It works by stopping the growth of parasites causing the infection. This medicine usually makes you feel better quite quickly. However, you should continue taking it as long as it is prescribed even when you feel better, to make sure that all parasites are killed and do not become resistant.
mechanismOfAction:
How METROGYL 200 TABLET Works

METROGYL 200 TABLET contains a medicine called Metronidazole which is an antiprotozoal drug that kills bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. As a result, it kills the infection-causing germs and controls their future growth and multiplication, reducing the severity of the infection.
usageInstructions: Take METROGYL 200 TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow METROGYL 200 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken after food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to infection may come back.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not consume alcohol during the course of treatment and for at least 48 hours after finishing the medication.
Inform Your Doctor if you have or had conditions such as kidney, liver and other neurological disorders like seizures or peripheral neuropathy

METROGYL 200 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Have a history of seizures

name: Maxolid Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MAXOLID TABLET

MAXOLID TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking MAXOLID TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with MAXOLID TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take MAXOLID TABLET for more than 28 days. 

MAXOLID TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MAXOLID TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking MAXOLID TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

MAXOLID TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take MAXOLID TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MAXOLID TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)

Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))

Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking MAXOLID TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MAXOLID TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

name: Coligyl Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About COLIGYL DRY SYRUP

COLIGYL DRY SYRUP contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in infants and in children to manage bacterial infections of the gut (stomach and intestines).

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before starting the therapy with COLIGYL DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if your child has any kidney problems. Your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin to your child and constantly monitor their kidney functions to avoid the risk of side effects. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any inherited blood or muscle disorders before starting the therapy with COLIGYL DRY SYRUP.

Do not give COLIGYL DRY SYRUP to your child if your child is allergic to any of its ingredients. The most common side effects of taking COLIGYL DRY SYRUP are stomach upset, nausea, vomiting, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen in your child.
