Manages bacterial infections of the gut in infants and in children
mechanismOfAction:
How COLIGYL DRY SYRUP Works

COLIGYL DRY SYRUP kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use COLIGYL DRY SYRUP

Use COLIGYL DRY SYRUP as advised by your physician. Reconstitute the medicine with the sterile water given along with the package or with boiled, cooled water before administration. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture vigorously for at least 10-15 minutes until it forms a uniform mixture. Measure the medicine using the measuring cup given along with the package and administer it to your child.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, quantity (ml), and duration of therapy for your child depending upon their age, body weight, and severity of infection. Shake the medicine well before each use. Do not stop giving COLIGYL DRY SYRUP to your child without consulting your doctor, even if they feel better after a few days of therapy. Continue to give COLIGYL DRY SYRUP for the stipulated duration mentioned by your doctor to achieve maximum benefits.

introduction:
Introduction About NORDYS 400MG TABLET

NORDYS 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking NORDYS 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NORDYS 400MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How NORDYS 400MG TABLET Works

NORDYS 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About FOSINTA SACHET

FOSINTA SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

FOSINTA SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

FOSINTA SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. FOSINTA SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
usesDetails:

Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
mechanismOfAction:
How FOSINTA SACHET Works

FOSINTA SACHET works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

Take FOSINTA SACHET as advised by your physician. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: LYNX Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About LYNX INJECTION

LYNX INJECTION contains Lincomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Lincosamides. LYNX INJECTION is used alone/combined with other antibiotics to manage serious infections caused by susceptible strains of streptococci, pneumococci, and staphylococci bacteria in affected individuals when other antibiotics become ineffective to manage the disease due to penicillin allergy/ bacterial resistance.

LYNX INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients allergic to lincomycin, and/or clindamycin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with minor bacterial/viral infections.

Before administering LYNX INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have stomach problems (such as gastrointestinal disease), monilial infection (yeast infection), lung problems (such as asthma), kidney problems (severe renal dysfunction), and/or liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function).

LYNX INJECTION should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. The medicine is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless it is clearly necessary since the medicine may pass through breast milk.

LYNX INJECTION should be administered with caution in children and adolescents (aged above 1 month to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The common side effects of receiving LYNX INJECTION are diarrhoea, nausea, vomiting, swelling near the injection site, and/or dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.
uses: Manage serious infections caused by susceptible strains of streptococci, pneumococci, and staphylococci bacteria in affected individuals when other antibiotics become ineffective to manage the disease due to penicillin allergy/ bacterial resistance

Uses Of LYNX INJECTION
Manage serious infections caused by susceptible strains of streptococci, pneumococci, and staphylococci bacteria in affected individuals when other antibiotics become ineffective to manage the disease due to penicillin allergy/ bacterial resistance
mechanismOfAction:
How LYNX INJECTION Works

LYNX INJECTION works by binding to bacterial genetic material (RNA) and cause inhibition of synthesis of certain essential proteins in bacteria which leads to its destruction and manage its spread to other parts of the body thus managing infections caused by susceptible bacteria in affected individuals.
usageDetails:
How to use LYNX INJECTION

LYNX INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse as an intravenous injection in a vein, intramuscular injection in a muscle, and/or subconjunctival injection underneath the conjunctiva lining the eyelid. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: RIFASTOP 550 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RIFASTOP 550 TABLET

RIFASTOP 550 TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFASTOP 550 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFASTOP 550 TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFASTOP 550 TABLET Works

RIFASTOP 550 TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine

Do not stop taking the medicine without consulting your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy

introduction:
Introduction About UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET

UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract

mechanismOfAction:
How UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET Works

UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.
usageDetails:
How to use UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET

Take UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. UGICLEAN NF 100MG TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

introduction:
Introduction About RIFALET 200MG TABLET

RIFALET 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFALET 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFALET 200MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFALET 200MG TABLET Works

RIFALET 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About RCIFAX SUSPENSION

RCIFAX SUSPENSION is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) to manage infectious diarrhea. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics which works against the susceptible bacteria that causes infection by blocking the actions of certain enzymes in the bacteria that is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the growth and multiplication of the harmful bacteria in the gut and controls diarrhea.

Take RCIFAX SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Inform your doctor if you can’t notice any improvement in your condition or if you feel worse after 3 days of therapy. It is not recommended for use in patients with bloody diarrhea or diarrhea accompanied by fever and in patients passing unformed (soft or liquid) stools for more than 8 times a day. It is also not suitable for use in patients having any stomach problems (such as constipation, vomiting, or stomach pain due to blockage in the gut).

Inform your doctor before taking RCIFAX SUSPENSION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding women. This medicine may cause pink or reddish discoloration of urine. This usually disappears after discontinuation of the therapy. The most common side effects of taking headache, flatulence, stomach pain, constipation, urge to empty bowels and fever. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: CARYLID 600 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About CARYLID 600 TABLET

CARYLID 600 TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with CARYLID 600 TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take CARYLID 600 TABLET for more than 28 days. 

CARYLID 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. CARYLID 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking CARYLID 600 TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CARYLID 600 TABLET Works

CARYLID 600 TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use CARYLID 600 TABLET

Take CARYLID 600 TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow CARYLID 600 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse CARYLID 600 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take CARYLID 600 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

warnings.details: CARYLID 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor. Consult your doctor before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.
CARYLID 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and could affect the baby. Consult your doctor before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or problems with your vision after taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol (especially draught beers and wine) while taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.
CARYLID 600 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney problems, especially if the patient is on dialysis. Consult your doctor before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.
CARYLID 600 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.
Do not take CARYLID 600 TABLET if you are allergic to Linezolid or any other ingredients of this medicine.
CARYLID 600 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.
CARYLID 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

CARYLID 600 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition that affects the blood, bone marrow, or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET.

Others

Before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have an overactive thyroid
Have an adrenal gland tumor (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome (tumors of the hormone system causing diarrhea, flushing of the skin, and wheezing)
Have mental disorders such as manic depression, schizoaffective disorder, mental confusion, or other mental problems
Bruise and bleed easily
Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhea
Have phenylketonuria (a rare genetic disorder that causes certain amino acids to build up in the body)
Have any scheduled surgery

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CARYLID 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking CARYLID 600 TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CARYLID 600 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About FOSFOE POWDER

FOSFOE POWDER contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

FOSFOE POWDER should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

FOSFOE POWDER is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. FOSFOE POWDER is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How FOSFOE POWDER Works

FOSFOE POWDER works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

name: LINECA Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LINECA TABLET

LINECA TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINECA TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINECA TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINECA TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINECA TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINECA TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINECA TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)

How LINECA TABLET Works

LINECA TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

How to use LINECA TABLET

Take LINECA TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LINECA TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LINECA TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINECA TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LINECA TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)

Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINECA TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LINECA TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

introduction:
Introduction About CIBOZ 400MG TABLET

CIBOZ 400MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking CIBOZ 400MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CIBOZ 400MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How CIBOZ 400MG TABLET Works

CIBOZ 400MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET

FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
usesDetails:
Uses Of FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET
Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
mechanismOfAction:
How FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET Works

FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.
usageDetails:
How to use FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET

Take FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET as advised by your physician. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Serious allergic reaction symptoms such as swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat with breathing difficulties (angioedema)

FOEPHOS VANILLA FLAVOUR SACHET should be taken with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Linospan Injection 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About LINOSPAN INJECTION

LINOSPAN INJECTION contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).

Bacterial infections are caused by multiplication of specific harmful strain of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or stomach pain.

Before receiving LINOSPAN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anemia or low blood sodium levels (hyponatremia), history of seizures, diarrhea or if you are prone to get infection.

During management with LINOSPAN INJECTION, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you receive LINOSPAN INJECTION for more than 28 days.

LINOSPAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINOSPAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving LINOSPAN INJECTION are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, metallic taste in the mouth and indigestion. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How LINOSPAN INJECTION Works

LINOSPAN INJECTION works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

How to use LINOSPAN INJECTION

LINOSPAN INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LINOSPAN INJECTION for you depending on your age, body weight, severity and type of the infection.

Vision problems (like blurred vision, changes in color vision, difficulty in seeing detail, or restricted field of vision)
Severe diarrhea with blood or mucus (it may develop into complications which are life-threatening)
Repeated nausea or vomiting, abdominal pain or rapid breathing
Fits or seizures or serotonin syndrome (signs include agitation, confusion, mental disturbance, rigidity, shaking, incoordination, seizure, rapid heart rate and severe breathing problems)
Unexplained bleeding or bruising
Changes in the numbers of certain blood cells which may lead to infection (signs of infection include fever, sore throat, mouth ulcers and tiredness)
Inflammation of the pancreas
Transient ischaemic attacks (temporary disturbance of the flow of blood to the brain causing short-term symptoms such as loss of vision, leg and arm weakness, slurring of speech and loss of consciousness)
Ringing in the ears (tinnitus)
New or worsening myelosuppression (fewer blood cells due to bone marrow suppression)
Syndrome of inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion (SIADH) causing confusion, sleepiness, generalized weakness and respiratory failure

name: COMXTIN Oral Suspension 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION

COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in infants and in children to manage bacterial infections of the gut (stomach and intestines).

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before starting the therapy with COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if your child has any kidney problems. Your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin to your child and constantly monitor their kidney functions to avoid the risk of side effects. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any inherited blood or muscle disorders before starting the therapy with COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION.

Do not give COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION to your child if your child is allergic to any of its ingredients. The most common side effects of taking COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION are stomach upset, nausea, vomiting, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen in your child.

mechanismOfAction:
How COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION Works

COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION

Use COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Reconstitute the medicine with the sterile water given along with the package or with boiled, cooled water before administration. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture vigorously for at least 10-15 minutes until it forms a uniform mixture. Measure the medicine using the measuring cup given along with the package and administer it to your child.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, quantity (ml), and duration of therapy for your child depending upon their age, body weight, and severity of infection. Shake the medicine well before each use. Do not stop giving COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION to your child without consulting your doctor, even if they feel better after a few days of therapy. Continue to give COMXTIN ORAL SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration mentioned by your doctor to achieve maximum benefits.

introduction:
Introduction About RAFLE 200MG TABLET

RAFLE 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RAFLE 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RAFLE 200MG TABLET Works

RAFLE 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Rifaset 100mg Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About RIFASET 100MG SUSPENSION

RIFASET 100MG SUSPENSION is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) to manage infectious diarrhea. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics which works against the susceptible bacteria that causes infection by blocking the actions of certain enzymes in the bacteria that is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the growth and multiplication of the harmful bacteria in the gut and controls diarrhea.

Take RIFASET 100MG SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Inform your doctor if you can’t notice any improvement in your condition or if you feel worse after 3 days of therapy. It is not recommended for use in patients with bloody diarrhea or diarrhea accompanied by fever and in patients passing unformed (soft or liquid) stools for more than 8 times a day. It is also not suitable for use in patients having any stomach problems (such as constipation, vomiting, or stomach pain due to blockage in the gut).

Inform your doctor before taking RIFASET 100MG SUSPENSION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding women. This medicine may cause pink or reddish discoloration of urine. This usually disappears after discontinuation of the therapy. The most common side effects of taking headache, flatulence, stomach pain, constipation, urge to empty bowels and fever. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION

XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of serious bacterial infections when other antibiotics are not suitable. It is clinically effective in managing various infections caused by certain gram-negative bacteria, such as Aerobacter aerogenes, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

A bacterial infection can be defined as a proliferation of various harmful strains of bacteria in the body. They can affect any part(s) of the body, including the respiratory tract, urinary tract, eyes, ears, skin, soft tissue, or bones.

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before receiving XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. To avoid side effects, your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin and constantly monitor your kidney functions while receiving XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION. You must also inform your doctor if you have any inherited blood or muscle disorders before receiving XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION.

Do not take XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION if you are allergic to any of the ingredients present in it. XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if prescribed by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION are stomach upset, tingling sensation in the extremities, loss of sensation, fever, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

How XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION Works

XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.

XYLISTIN FORTE 2MIU INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and severity of infection.

name: EVAFOS Powder 8gm
introduction:
Introduction About EVAFOS POWDER

EVAFOS POWDER contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

EVAFOS POWDER should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

EVAFOS POWDER is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. EVAFOS POWDER is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How EVAFOS POWDER Works

EVAFOS POWDER works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

introduction:
Introduction About LYNX 250MG CAPSULE

LYNX 250MG CAPSULE contains Lincomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Lincosamides. LYNX 250MG CAPSULE is used to manage the infections caused by susceptible strains of gram-positive bacteria (such as streptococci, pneumococci, staphylococci), and/or susceptible strains of anaerobic bacteria in affected individuals.

LYNX 250MG CAPSULE is also used to manage upper respiratory infections (including tonsillitis, pharyngitis, otitis media, sinusitis, scarlet fever), lower respiratory infections (including acute & chronic bronchitis, pneumonia), and skin & soft tissue infections.

LYNX 250MG CAPSULE is also indicated for use to manage bone & joint infections (including osteomyelitis, septic arthritis), septicaemia (life threatening complication of an infection), endocarditis (inflammation of heart valve), and bacillary dysentery.

LYNX 250MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients allergic to lincomycin, and/or clindamycin. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from meningitis (inflammation of membranes surrounding brain and spinal cord).

Before taking LYNX 250MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have diarrhoea, liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function), and/or kidney problems (such as severe kidney impairment).

LYNX 250MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary.

LYNX 250MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in children and adolescents (aged above 1 month to 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking LYNX 250MG CAPSULE are diarrhoea, nausea, and/or vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About ICUFOS O VANILLA FLAVOUR POWDER

ICUFOS O VANILLA FLAVOUR POWDER contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

ICUFOS O VANILLA FLAVOUR POWDER should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

ICUFOS O VANILLA FLAVOUR POWDER is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. ICUFOS O VANILLA FLAVOUR POWDER is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How ICUFOS O VANILLA FLAVOUR POWDER Works

ICUFOS O VANILLA FLAVOUR POWDER works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

name: Linetic 600mg Injection 300ml
introduction:
Introduction About LINETIC 600MG INJECTION

LINETIC 600MG INJECTION contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).    

Bacterial infections are caused by multiplication of specific harmful strain of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or stomach pain.  

Before receiving LINETIC 600MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anemia or low blood sodium levels (hyponatremia), history of seizures, diarrhea or if you are prone to get infection.  

During management with LINETIC 600MG INJECTION, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you receive LINETIC 600MG INJECTION for more than 28 days. 

LINETIC 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINETIC 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of receiving LINETIC 600MG INJECTION are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, metallic taste in the mouth and indigestion. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How LINETIC 600MG INJECTION Works

LINETIC 600MG INJECTION works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

LINETIC 600MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LINETIC 600MG INJECTION for you depending on your age, body weight, severity and type of the infection.

Others

Before receiving LINETIC 600MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have an overactive thyroid
Have adrenal glands tumor (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome (tumors of the hormone system causing diarrhoea, flushing of the skin and wheezing)
Have mental disorders such as manic depression, schizoaffective disorder, mental confusion or other mental problems
Bruise and bleed easily
Have history of low blood sodium levels
Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhea

LINETIC 600MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice. 

Use in geriatrics:     

LINETIC 600MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (condition which affects the blood, bone marrow or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

Interactions

A.Drug-Drug interactions:

Before receiving LINETIC 600MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, moclobemide)

Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))

Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts or soya bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while receiving LINETIC 600MG INJECTION as it may react with a substance called tyramine which is naturally present in some foods and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About FAXICAD 200MG TABLET

FAXICAD 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking FAXICAD 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FAXICAD 200MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How FAXICAD 200MG TABLET Works

FAXICAD 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION

TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION contains Teicoplanin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections like infections of the skin and beneath the skin (soft tissue), bones and joints, lungs, urinary tract, heart (endocarditis), abdominal wall (peritonitis) and the blood.

Bacterial infections are caused by multiplication of specific harmful strain of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, extreme tiredness, swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere, headache, nausea or vomiting.

Before receiving TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have flushing of the upper part of the body (red man syndrome), a decrease in platelet count (thrombocytopenia) and kidney problems or liver problems.  

TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children (including newborns) or adolescents and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION are rash, skin redness, itching, pain and fever. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION Works

TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION contains Teicoplanin which works by inhibiting the formation of bacterial cell wall, thereby impairing the bonds that hold the bacterial cell wall together. This allows holes in the bacterial cell wall, which kills the bacteria. Thus, helps in managing and managing the spread of infections.

TARGOCID 400MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous injection or into a muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: ORNIDA IV Infusion 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About ORNIDA IV INFUSION

ORNIDA IV INFUSION contains Ornidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage susceptible protozoal infections and anaerobic bacterial infections.

Symptoms of infections generally include fever, extreme tiredness, swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere, headache, nausea or vomiting. Your doctor might want to take certain blood tests prior to the management.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving ORNIDA IV INFUSION. Before receiving ORNIDA IV INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have epilepsy, multiple sclerosis, kidney problems or liver disease. ORNIDA IV INFUSION is not recommended for use among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding.

ORNIDA IV INFUSION should be used with caution in children and adolescents. The most common side effects of receiving ORNIDA IV INFUSION are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, epigastric discomfort and dry mouth. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen with time.
uses: Manage susceptible protozoal infections and anaerobic bacterial infections
usesDetails:

Manage susceptible protozoal infections and anaerobic bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How ORNIDA IV INFUSION Works

ORNIDA IV INFUSION contains ornidazole which is an antiprotozoal that kills parasites and bacteria that live in the absence of oxygen by generating harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use ORNIDA IV INFUSION

ORNIDA IV INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an injection or intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the proper dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Loss of appetite, nausea, diarrhea, vomiting
Allergic reactions (severe skin rash, itching, hives, swollen face, lips, mouth, throat, hands, feet or ankles, difficulty in swallowing or breathing)
sideEffectsDetails:

Common

Headache, vertigo
Muscle rigidity

Rare

Allergic reactions (severe skin rash, itching, hives, swollen face, lips, mouth, throat, hands, feet or ankles, difficulty in swallowing or breathing)

warnings.details: ORNIDA IV INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women or women planning to have a baby unless the benefits of management outweigh the risk to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
ORNIDA IV INFUSION should be used with caution in breastfeeding women as it is not known if it passes in the breastmilk. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy, drowsiness, light headedness after receiving ORNIDA IV INFUSION.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving ORNIDA IV INFUSION and for at least 3 days after finishing the management as it may worsen the side effects.
ORNIDA IV INFUSION should be used with caution in patients on haemodialysis. Dose will be adjusted by your doctor. Consult your doctor receiving it.
ORNIDA IV INFUSION should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Dose will be adjusted by your doctor. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not receive ORNIDA IV INFUSION if you are allergic to Ornidazole, metronidazole or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.

Others

Before receiving ORNIDA IV INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have:

Epilepsy
Multiple sclerosis

Use in pediatrics:

ORNIDA IV INFUSION dose will be adjusted by your doctor depending on your age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

name: RIFORTE 550 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RIFORTE 550 TABLET

RIFORTE 550 TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFORTE 550 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFORTE 550 TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFORTE 550 TABLET Works

RIFORTE 550 TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection
Do not stop taking the medicine without consulting your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy

introduction:
Introduction About FLAGYL SUSPENSION

FLAGYL SUSPENSION contains Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoal drugs. It is used to manage various bacterial and parasitic infections in the body such as amoebiasis, giardiasis (parasitic infection causing severe diarrhea with stomach cramps), trichomonas vaginitis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), infections of the blood, brain, lungs, bones, stomach (Ex. H. pylori infection), pelvis, urinary tract, genital tract (vaginal infections) and gums and teeth (Ex. gingivitis or other dental infections).

It can also be used in the management of infected leg ulcers or pressure sores and helps in the management of post-surgical infections and infections following childbirth. Take FLAGYL SUSPENSION during or just after meals. It is important to take the full course of the therapy to achieve better control over infection. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking FLAGYL SUSPENSION as it could increase the risk of dizziness and drowsiness.

Before taking FLAGYL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking FLAGYL SUSPENSION are lack of appetite, nausea, metallic taste in mouth and stomach cramps. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

RIFIGON 200 TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. Before taking RIFIGON 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. mechanismOfAction:
How RIFIGON 200 TABLET Works

RIFIGON 200 TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. introduction:
Introduction About ZOLIDPOS TABLET

ZOLIDPOS TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking ZOLIDPOS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with ZOLIDPOS TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take ZOLIDPOS TABLET for more than 28 days. 

ZOLIDPOS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. ZOLIDPOS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking ZOLIDPOS TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ZOLIDPOS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking ZOLIDPOS TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of ZOLIDPOS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

name: Coligyl DS Dry Syrup 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP

COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in infants and in children to manage bacterial infections of the gut (stomach and intestines).

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before starting the therapy with COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP, inform your doctor if your child has any kidney problems. Your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin to your child and constantly monitor their kidney functions to avoid the risk of side effects. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any inherited blood or muscle disorders before starting the therapy with COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP.

Do not give COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP to your child if your child is allergic to any of its ingredients. The most common side effects of taking COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP are stomach upset, nausea, vomiting, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen in your child.

mechanismOfAction:
How COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP Works

COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP

Use COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP as advised by your physician. Reconstitute the medicine with the sterile water given along with the package or with boiled, cooled water before administration. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture vigorously for at least 10-15 minutes until it forms a uniform mixture. Measure the medicine using the measuring cup given along with the package and administer it to your child.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, quantity (ml), and duration of therapy for your child depending upon their age, body weight, and severity of infection. Shake the medicine well before each use. Do not stop giving COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP to your child without consulting your doctor, even if they feel better after a few days of therapy. Continue to give COLIGYL DS DRY SYRUP for the stipulated duration mentioned by your doctor to achieve maximum benefits.

introduction:
Introduction About SIBOCURE 200 TABLET

SIBOCURE 200 TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking SIBOCURE 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How SIBOCURE 200 TABLET Works

SIBOCURE 200 TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Clorni Gel 10gm
introduction:
Introduction About CLORNI GEL

CLORNI GEL contains Ornidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage periodontal disease (periodontitis), gingivitis (gum inflammation), aphthous stomatitis (sore or ulcers in the mouth or gums). Periodontal disease is a condition that affects the supporting structure of teeth leading to the formation of pockets due to which tooth loss occurs.

Ornidazole is an antiprotozoal that kills parasites and bacteria that live in the absence of oxygen by generating harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria.

CLORNI GEL should be used with caution among women who are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effect of using CLORNI GEL is application site irritation. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About RIFAXIGRESS 200MG TABLET

RIFAXIGRESS 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAXIGRESS 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:

Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAXIGRESS 200MG TABLET Works

RIFAXIGRESS 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Walamycin Suspension 30ml
introduction:
Introduction About WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION

WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in infants and in children to manage bacterial infections of the gut (stomach and intestines).

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before starting the therapy with WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if your child has any kidney problems. Your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin to your child and constantly monitor their kidney functions to avoid the risk of side effects. You must also inform your doctor if your child has any inherited blood or muscle disorders before starting the therapy with WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION.

Do not give WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION to your child if your child is allergic to any of its ingredients. The most common side effects of taking WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION are stomach upset, nausea, vomiting, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen in your child.

mechanismOfAction:
How WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION Works

WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION

Use WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. Reconstitute the medicine with the sterile water given along with the package or with boiled, cooled water before administration. Close the bottle tightly and shake the mixture vigorously for at least 10-15 minutes until it forms a uniform mixture. Measure the medicine using the measuring cup given along with the package and administer it to your child.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose, quantity (ml), and duration of therapy for your child depending upon their age, body weight, and severity of infection. Shake the medicine well before each use. Do not stop giving WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION to your child without consulting your doctor, even if they feel better after a few days of therapy. Continue to give WALAMYCIN SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration mentioned by your doctor to achieve maximum benefits.

name: VOXYLID IV Infusion 300ml
introduction:
Introduction About VOXYLID IV INFUSION

VOXYLID IV INFUSION contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or stomach pain.

Before receiving VOXYLID IV INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anaemia or low blood sodium levels (hyponatremia), history of seizures, diarrhoea or if you are prone to get an infection.

During management with VOXYLID IV INFUSION, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you receive VOXYLID IV INFUSION for more than 28 days.

VOXYLID IV INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. VOXYLID IV INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving VOXYLID IV INFUSION are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, metallic taste in the mouth and indigestion. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:

Manages bacterial infections like:

Pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired)

mechanismOfAction:
How VOXYLID IV INFUSION Works

VOXYLID IV INFUSION works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use VOXYLID IV INFUSION

VOXYLID IV INFUSION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of VOXYLID IV INFUSION for you depending on your age, body weight, severity and type of the infection.

VOXYLID IV INFUSION should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before receiving VOXYLID IV INFUSION.

Have a history of low blood sodium levels

VOXYLID IV INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition which affects the blood, bone marrow or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before receiving it.
