name: Gifaxin 100mg Suspension 60ml
introduction:
Introduction About GIFAXIN 100MG SYRUP

GIFAXIN 100MG SYRUP is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) to manage infectious diarrhea. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics which works against the susceptible bacteria that causes infection by blocking the actions of certain enzymes in the bacteria that is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the growth and multiplication of the harmful bacteria in the gut and controls diarrhea.

Take GIFAXIN 100MG SYRUP for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Inform your doctor if you can’t notice any improvement in your condition or if you feel worse after 3 days of therapy. It is not recommended for use in patients with bloody diarrhea or diarrhea accompanied by fever and in patients passing unformed (soft or liquid) stools for more than 8 times a day. It is also not suitable for use in patients having any stomach problems (such as constipation, vomiting, or stomach pain due to blockage in the gut).

Inform your doctor before taking GIFAXIN 100MG SYRUP if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding women. This medicine may cause pink or reddish discoloration of urine. This usually disappears after discontinuation of the therapy. The most common side effects of taking headache, flatulence, stomach pain, constipation, urge to empty bowels and fever. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About LIZOLID INJECTION

LIZOLID INJECTION contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).

Bacterial infections are caused by multiplication of specific harmful strain of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea or stomach pain.

Before receiving LIZOLID INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anemia or low blood sodium levels (hyponatremia), history of seizures, diarrhea or if you are prone to get infection.

During management with LIZOLID INJECTION, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you receive LIZOLID INJECTION for more than 28 days.

LIZOLID INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LIZOLID INJECTION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving LIZOLID INJECTION are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, metallic taste in the mouth and indigestion. Inform your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

How LIZOLID INJECTION Works

LIZOLID INJECTION works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

LIZOLID INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a vein as an intravenous infusion. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of LIZOLID INJECTION for you depending on your age, body weight, severity and type of the infection.

name: ERAFOS Sachet 8gm
introduction:
Introduction About ERAFOS SACHET

ERAFOS SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

ERAFOS SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

ERAFOS SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. ERAFOS SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION

TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION contains Teicoplanin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial infections like infections of the skin and beneath the skin (soft tissue), bones and joints, lungs, urinary tract, heart (endocarditis), abdominal wall (peritonitis) and the blood.

Bacterial infections are caused by multiplication of specific harmful strain of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, extreme tiredness, swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere, headache, nausea or vomiting.

Before receiving TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have flushing of the upper part of the body (red man syndrome), a decrease in platelet count (thrombocytopenia) and kidney problems or liver problems.  

TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless advised by the doctor. TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION should be used with caution in children (including newborns) or adolescents and in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of receiving TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION are rash, skin redness, itching, pain and fever. Inform your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION Works

TARGOCID 200MG INJECTION contains Teicoplanin which works by inhibiting the formation of bacterial cell wall, thereby impairing the bonds that hold the bacterial cell wall together. This allows holes in the bacterial cell wall, which kills the bacteria. Thus, helps in managing and managing the spread of infections.

name: LIZOFORCE Infusion 300ml
introduction:
Introduction About LIZOFORCE INFUSION

LIZOFORCE INFUSION contains Linezolid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), complicated and uncomplicated skin and soft tissue infections caused by susceptible bacteria. It is also used to manage vancomycin-resistant enterococcus faecium infections, including cases with concurrent bacteremia (viable bacteria in the blood).

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, child and sweats, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea or stomach pain.

Before receiving LIZOFORCE INFUSION, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder) overactive thyroid, anaemia or low blood sodium levels (hyponatremia), history of seizures, diarrhoea or if you are prone to get an infection.

During management with LIZOFORCE INFUSION, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you receive LIZOFORCE INFUSION for more than 28 days.

LIZOFORCE INFUSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LIZOFORCE INFUSION is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of receiving LIZOFORCE INFUSION are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, metallic taste in the mouth and indigestion. Inform your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How LIZOFORCE INFUSION Works

LIZOFORCE INFUSION works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.

Have an overactive thyroid

Bruise and bleed easily
Have a history of low blood sodium levels
Are anaemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections

Have diarrhoea

LIZOFORCE INFUSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition which affects the blood, bone marrow or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before receiving it.

introduction:
Introduction About LUPIFOS POWDER

LUPIFOS POWDER contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

LUPIFOS POWDER should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

LUPIFOS POWDER is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. LUPIFOS POWDER is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
usesDetails:
Uses Of LUPIFOS POWDER
Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents
Prophylactic management of transrectal prostate biopsy in adult man
mechanismOfAction:
How LUPIFOS POWDER Works

LUPIFOS POWDER works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.

introduction:
Introduction About CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE

CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE.

CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE
Manage severe bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE Works

CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE

Take CLINBID 300MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NIFTAS 100MG TABLET

NIFTAS 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NIFTAS 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result. NIFTAS 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NIFTAS 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NIFTAS 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking NIFTAS 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About LINZIXO 600 TABLET

LINZIXO 600 TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINZIXO 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINZIXO 600 TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINZIXO 600 TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINZIXO 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINZIXO 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINZIXO 600 TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How LINZIXO 600 TABLET Works

LINZIXO 600 TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LINZIXO 600 TABLET

Take LINZIXO 600 TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LINZIXO 600 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LINZIXO 600 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINZIXO 600 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LINZIXO 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINZIXO 600 TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About NITROFORCE 100 TABLET

NITROFORCE 100 TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NITROFORCE 100 TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NITROFORCE 100 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NITROFORCE 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NITROFORCE 100 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NITROFORCE 100 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

name: Horn Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About HORN TABLET

HORN TABLET contains Ornidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage infections that are caused by anaerobic bacteria (bacteria that do not use oxygen) or amoeba (single-celled parasites). Infections include certain types of vaginal, urinary tract and intestinal infections or some specific infections in the body. It is also used as prophylaxis during surgery to manage these types of infections.

Before taking HORN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have epilepsy, multiple sclerosis (disease which affects the central nervous system), liver disease or if you are undergoing hemodialysis. Your doctor might advise you to take certain blood tests prior to management with HORN TABLET to understand the existing condition and to safely use this medicine.

HORN TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless clearly advised by the doctor and it should be used with caution in breast-feeding women. HORN TABLET can be used in children and your child’s doctor may adjust the dose depending upon child’s body weight and type of the infection. 

While taking this medicine you may experience side effects such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dry mouth and loss of appetite. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manage certain types of vaginal, urinary tract and intestinal infections or other specific infections in the body
Used as prophylaxis during surgery (particularly involving the colon and in gynaecological operations)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How HORN TABLET Works

HORN TABLET contains ornidazole which is an antiprotozoal agent that kills parasites and bacteria (that lives in the absence of oxygen) by generating harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria, thus helps to manage certain types of infections.
usageDetails:
How to use HORN TABLET

Take HORN TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Avoid taking this medicine on empty stomach. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of HORN TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Foracne Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About FORACNE GEL

FORACNE GEL contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of acne vulgaris. Acne vulgaris is a common skin condition that occurs when hair follicles get blocked with oil and dead skin cells. Symptoms include whiteheads, blackheads, small red, tender bumps, pimples, and pus-filled lumps on the skin.

Before applying FORACNE GEL, inform your doctor if you have or ever had diarrhea, bloody diarrhea and pseudomembranous colitis. FORACNE GEL is not recommended for use if you have a history of regional enteritis (inflammation of the small intestine), ulcerative colitis (inflammation of the large intestine) or antibiotic-associated colitis.

FORACNE GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy or by breastfeeding women only if clearly needed. The safety and effectiveness of FORACNE GEL in children under the age of 12 has not been established. The most common side effects of applying FORACNE GEL are burning, itching, and redness of the skin. Consult your doctor if symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of FORACNE GEL
Manage acne vulgaris
mechanismOfAction:
How FORACNE GEL Works

FORACNE GEL acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis), which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use FORACNE GEL

Apply FORACNE GEL as advised by your physician. It is for external use only. Wash your hands before use. Wash and dry the whole area, apply a thin film once daily to the skin where acne lesions appear and use enough to cover the entire affected area. In case of contact with the eyes, mouth or nostrils, rinse it off immediately and thoroughly with water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Burning, itching or abnormal redness of the skin at the application site
Scaling, pain, dryness and skin irritation at the application site
Allergic symptoms (e.g., rashes, itchiness, difficulty in breathing or eye swelling)
Severe or bloody diarrhea. (a sign of bowel inflammation, pseudomembranous colitis)

name: LINZOLINE 600 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About LINZOLINE 600 TABLET

LINZOLINE 600 TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with LINZOLINE 600 TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take LINZOLINE 600 TABLET for more than 28 days. 

LINZOLINE 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. LINZOLINE 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How LINZOLINE 600 TABLET Works

LINZOLINE 600 TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use LINZOLINE 600 TABLET

Take LINZOLINE 600 TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow LINZOLINE 600 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse LINZOLINE 600 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take LINZOLINE 600 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

LINZOLINE 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and could affect the baby. Consult your doctor before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness or problems with your vision after taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol (especially draught beers and wine) while taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET.
LINZOLINE 600 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with kidney problems, especially if the patient is on dialysis. Consult your doctor before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET.
LINZOLINE 600 TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with liver problems. Consult your doctor before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET.
Do not take LINZOLINE 600 TABLET if you are allergic to Linezolid or any other ingredients of this medicine.
LINZOLINE 600 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET.
LINZOLINE 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

LINZOLINE 600 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition that affects the blood, bone marrow, or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET.

Others

Before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have an overactive thyroid
Have an adrenal gland tumor (phaeochromocytoma) or carcinoid syndrome (tumors of the hormone system causing diarrhea, flushing of the skin, and wheezing)
Have mental disorders such as manic depression, schizoaffective disorder, mental confusion, or other mental problems
Bruise and bleed easily
Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections
Have a history of seizures
Have diarrhea
Have phenylketonuria (a rare genetic disorder that causes certain amino acids to build up in the body)
Have any scheduled surgery

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking LINZOLINE 600 TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of LINZOLINE 600 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

name: ARISTOGYL 200 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET

ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET is used in the management of various bacterial and parasitic infections such as bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection), trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections, blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area infections, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It helps to manage an infection after surgery.

You can take ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET at any time of the day after food, but it is important to take it consistently at the same time each day. Continue taking the medicine for the duration prescribed by your doctor. Your symptoms may get better after a short time but do not stop taking it until you have finished a full course of treatment, even if you feel well. If you stop taking it early, some bacteria may survive, and the infection may come back. Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET and for a few days after stopping it. Otherwise, you may get unpleasant side effects like nausea, vomiting, and stomach pain.

Before taking ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system as a precaution. Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET is used in a high dose or for a prolonged time increases the risk of side effects such as nerve damage. Take it only as prescribed by your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET are headache, lack of appetite, nausea, dryness in mouth, metallic taste in mouth, stomach cramps and dizziness. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you. You can try using sugarless candies or lozenges to overcome any dryness or metallic taste in the mouth.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET

ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET is used to manage the following infection conditions:

Bacterial infections
Parasitic infections
Benefits of ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET:

1. Management of Bacterial infections:

ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET is a versatile antibiotic medicine that can be used to manage many different infections caused by bacteria. These include manage infections of the blood, brain, lung, bones, pelvic area, gum ulcers and other dental infections, leg ulcers and pressure sores. It can also be used to manage bacterial vaginosis (vaginal infection).

2. Management of Parasitic infections:

ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET is an antibiotic medicine that helps many parasitic infections such as trichomoniasis (parasitic infection of the genital tract), certain gastrointestinal infections and amoebic dysentery. It works by stopping the growth of parasites causing the infection. This medicine usually makes you feel better quite quickly. However, you should continue taking it as long as it is prescribed even when you feel better, to make sure that all parasites are killed and do not become resistant.
mechanismOfAction:
How ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET Works

ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET contains a medicine called Metronidazole which is an antiprotozoal drug that kills bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. As a result, it kills the infection-causing germs and controls their future growth and multiplication, reducing the severity of the infection.

Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to infection may come back.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not consume alcohol during the course of treatment and for at least 48 hours after finishing the medication.
Inform Your Doctor if you have or had conditions such as kidney, liver and other neurological disorders like seizures or peripheral neuropathy

warnings.details: ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET is generally considered safe to use during pregnancy. While there are limited human studies, animal research has shown low or no adverse effects to the developing baby. Please consult with your doctor for further guidance.
ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not suitable for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness, hallucination, or confusion while taking this medicine.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET as it may cause unpleasant side effects such as nausea and vomiting, stomach pain, hot flashes, irregular heartbeat, thirst, and headache.
ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (including dialysis). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Dose adjustment of ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET may be needed. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to Metronidazole or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking ARISTOGYL 200 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have any diseases affecting your nervous system
Have Cockayne syndrome (a rare genetic disorder characterized by short stature, low intellectual ability and neurological problems)
Have blood dyscrasias (a blood condition affecting blood components, bone marrow, lymph and blood vessels)
Have a history of seizures

introduction:
Introduction About FOSFONA SACHET

FOSFONA SACHET contains Fosfomycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage or manage uncomplicated infections of the bladder in women and female adolescents. It is also used as an antibiotic prophylaxis for transrectal prostate biopsy in men.

FOSFONA SACHET should not be used in patients who have severe kidney problems or are on haemodialysis. It should be used cautiously in patients who have persistent infections of the bladder and who have experienced symptoms of diarrhoea after taking any other antibiotics.

FOSFONA SACHET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered necessary and is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. FOSFONA SACHET is generally not recommended for use in children (under 12 years of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects are headaches, dizziness, diarrhoea, nausea and indigestion. If any of these symptoms worsen, contact your doctor.
uses: Manage or manages uncomplicated infection of the bladder in women and female adolescents

mechanismOfAction:
How FOSFONA SACHET Works

FOSFONA SACHET works by killing bacteria through the inactivation of an enzyme involved in bacterial cell wall synthesis and reduces adherence of the bacteria to the cells lining the urinary tract. This kind of action helps to manage uncomplicated urinary tract infections and manage infections after prostate biopsy.
usageDetails:

Take FOSFONA SACHET as advised by your physician. Check the label for directions before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About FURENT 100MG TABLET

FURENT 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. FURENT 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

FURENT 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

FURENT 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. FURENT 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking FURENT 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract
mechanismOfAction:
How FURENT 100MG TABLET Works

FURENT 100MG TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.

Take FURENT 100MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow FURENT 100MG TABLET with a glass of water and do not crush or chew it. Your doctor will decide the correct dose for you depending upon your age, body weight and the severity of infection. FURENT 100MG TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

introduction:
Introduction About URIVRON TABLET

URIVRON TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. URIVRON TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

URIVRON TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

URIVRON TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. URIVRON TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking URIVRON TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.
uses: Prevents and manage infections of the bladder, kidney and other parts of the urinary tract

mechanismOfAction:
How URIVRON TABLET Works

URIVRON TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.

URIVRON TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

name: Tinirob 500mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TINIROB 500MG TABLET

TINIROB 500MG TABLET is used in the management of post-operative infections caused by anaerobic bacteria, especially those associated with colonic, gastrointestinal and gynecological surgery. It is also used to manage intraperitoneal infections, gynecological infections, bacterial septicemia, post-operative wound infections, skin and soft tissue infections, upper and lower respiratory tract infections, non-specific vaginitis, acute ulcerative gingivitis, urogenital trichomoniasis in both male and female patients, giardiasis, intestinal amebiasis, amebic involvement of the liver. It contains Tinidazole which belongs to the group of medicines known as Anti-protozoals. It works against anaerobic bacteria and protozoa is believed to involve the penetration of the medicine into the cell of the microorganism and subsequent damage of DNA strands or inhibition of their synthesis.

TINIROB 500MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with organic neurological disorders and blood dyscrasias. TINIROB 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. It is not recommended for patients with first trimester in pregnancy. TINIROB 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mother.

There is no proper data available for the use of TINIROB 500MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effect of taking TINIROB 500MG TABLET are decreased appetite, headache, vertigo, vomiting, diarrhoea, nausea or abdominal pain. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions do I need to follow while taking TINIROB 500MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: TINIROB 500MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with organic neurological disorders and blood dyscrasias. TINIROB 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. It is not recommended for patients with first trimester in pregnancy. TINIROB 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mother.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if I stop taking TINIROB 500MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Do not stop taking TINIROB 500MG TABLET without talking to your doctor first. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: Is TINIROB 500MG TABLET safe to use in patients with kidney problems?
faqs.answer: A: Dosage adjustment in patients with impaired renal function are generally not necessary. However, because TINIROB 500MG TABLET is easily removed by haemodialysis, patients may require additional doses of TINIROB 500MG TABLET to compensate. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

faqs.question: Q: How long should TINIROB 500MG TABLET be taken?
faqs.answer: A: Take TINIROB 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It is recommended that TINIROB 500MG TABLET should be taken during or after a meal.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take TINIROB 500MG TABLET milk?
faqs.answer: A: Take TINIROB 500MG TABLET with food, including with milk, to lower your risk of stomach discomfort. But keep in mind that dairy products, like milk, are high in fat, which might cause some people to feel nauseous. This might worsen the side effects of the medicine. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: How long does TINIROB 500MG TABLET stay in the body?
faqs.answer: A: It can take between 2-3 days for most of TINIROB 500MG TABLET to leave the body. It is estimated based on the half-life of TINIROB 500MG TABLET. The medication stays in your system can also depend on your age and your health conditions, so it can be different for each individual person.

faqs.question: Q: Is TINIROB 500MG TABLET a strong antibiotic?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. TINIROB 500MG TABLET is an antibiotic effective against various bacterial infections in the intestines and vagina.

faqs.question: Q: Can TINIROB 500MG TABLET cure yeast infections?
faqs.answer: A: It is not typically used to manage yeast infections. It is primarily effective against bacterial infections. Consult your doctor if you experience vaginal itching or discharge.

faqs.question: Q: Can TINIROB 500MG TABLET be taken with alcohol?
faqs.answer: A: Avoid consuming alcohol while taking TINIROB 500MG TABLET and for at least 3 days after completing the course, as it may cause severe reactions like nausea, vomiting, and headache.

It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking GIFAXIN 550MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How GIFAXIN 550MG TABLET Works

GIFAXIN 550MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About FASIGYN 500MG TABLET

FASIGYN 500MG TABLET is used in the management of post-operative infections caused by anaerobic bacteria, especially those associated with colonic, gastrointestinal and gynecological surgery. It is also used to manage intraperitoneal infections, gynecological infections, bacterial septicemia, post-operative wound infections, skin and soft tissue infections, upper and lower respiratory tract infections, non-specific vaginitis, acute ulcerative gingivitis, urogenital trichomoniasis in both male and female patients, giardiasis, intestinal amebiasis, amebic involvement of the liver. It contains Tinidazole which belongs to the group of medicines known as Anti-protozoals. It works against anaerobic bacteria and protozoa is believed to involve the penetration of the medicine into the cell of the microorganism and subsequent damage of DNA strands or inhibition of their synthesis.

FASIGYN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with organic neurological disorders and blood dyscrasias. FASIGYN 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. It is not recommended for patients with first trimester in pregnancy. FASIGYN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mother.

There is no proper data available for the use of FASIGYN 500MG TABLET in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effect of taking FASIGYN 500MG TABLET are decreased appetite, headache, vertigo, vomiting, diarrhoea, nausea or abdominal pain. Consult your doctor if the side effects worsens or persists for a longer duration.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions do I need to follow while taking FASIGYN 500MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: FASIGYN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for patients with organic neurological disorders and blood dyscrasias. FASIGYN 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. It is not recommended for patients with first trimester in pregnancy. FASIGYN 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding mother.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if I stop taking FASIGYN 500MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Do not stop taking FASIGYN 500MG TABLET without talking to your doctor first. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: Is FASIGYN 500MG TABLET safe to use in patients with kidney problems?
faqs.answer: A: Dosage adjustment in patients with impaired renal function are generally not necessary. However, because FASIGYN 500MG TABLET is easily removed by haemodialysis, patients may require additional doses of FASIGYN 500MG TABLET to compensate. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

faqs.question: Q: How long should FASIGYN 500MG TABLET be taken?
faqs.answer: A: Take FASIGYN 500MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It is recommended that FASIGYN 500MG TABLET should be taken during or after a meal.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take FASIGYN 500MG TABLET milk?
faqs.answer: A: Take FASIGYN 500MG TABLET with food, including with milk, to lower your risk of stomach discomfort. But keep in mind that dairy products, like milk, are high in fat, which might cause some people to feel nauseous. This might worsen the side effects of the medicine. Consult your doctor for advice.

faqs.question: Q: How long does FASIGYN 500MG TABLET stay in the body?
faqs.answer: A: It can take between 2-3 days for most of FASIGYN 500MG TABLET to leave the body. It is estimated based on the half-life of FASIGYN 500MG TABLET. The medication stays in your system can also depend on your age and your health conditions, so it can be different for each individual person.

faqs.question: Q: Is FASIGYN 500MG TABLET a strong antibiotic?
faqs.answer: A: Yes. FASIGYN 500MG TABLET is an antibiotic effective against various bacterial infections in the intestines and vagina.

faqs.question: Q: Can FASIGYN 500MG TABLET cure yeast infections?
faqs.answer: A: It is not typically used to manage yeast infections. It is primarily effective against bacterial infections. Consult your doctor if you experience vaginal itching or discharge.

faqs.question: Q: Can FASIGYN 500MG TABLET be taken with alcohol?
faqs.answer: A: Avoid consuming alcohol while taking FASIGYN 500MG TABLET and for at least 3 days after completing the course, as it may cause severe reactions like nausea, vomiting, and headache.

CLINSOF 150MG TABLET contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking CLINSOF 150MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. CLINSOF 150MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking CLINSOF 150MG TABLET.

CLINSOF 150MG TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking CLINSOF 150MG TABLET are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.

introduction:
Introduction About NIFCLARE 100MG TABLET

NIFCLARE 100MG TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NIFCLARE 100MG TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NIFCLARE 100MG TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NIFCLARE 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NIFCLARE 100MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NIFCLARE 100MG TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

Any sudden wheeziness, difficulty in breathing, swelling of the eyelids, face or lips, rash or itching that affects your whole body
Fever, chills, cough and shortness of breath (reaction of lung with the medicine within a week or very slowly, mainly in elderly patients)
Yellowing of the skin or whites of the eyes (inflammation of the liver causing jaundice)
Changes in the sense of feeling and using muscles along with headache, extreme mood changes, confusion, weakness, blurred vision (due to affected nerves outside the spinal cord), which may be severe and permanent in some cases
Severe headaches (raised pressure in the skull)
Severe reduction in blood cells which results in weakness, bruising or more instance of infections
Blue or purple coloration of the skin (cyanosis causing low oxygen levels in the blood)
Signs of cutaneous vasculitis (fever, flu, abdominal pain, diarrhoea, blood in your stool, skin lesions and weakness)
Signs of autoimmune hepatitis (jaundice, fatigue, abdominal pain, joint pain and swelling)

introduction:
Introduction About SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET

SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET contains Secnidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage urethritis and vaginitis (urethral and vaginal inflammation) due to trichomonas vaginalis, intestinal and hepatic amebiasis (liver infection) and giardiasis (parasitic infection of the small intestine due to giardia parasite).

SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have a history of blood dyscrasia (abnormal condition or disease of the blood) or wheat allergy (condition that is different from celiac disease). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of unwanted effects. 

SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET is not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during pregnancy after the first trimester only if advised by the doctor. Also, it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET are nausea, gastrointestinal disturbances, metallic taste sensation and inflammation of the mouth or tongue. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Urethritis and vaginitis (due to trichomonas vaginalis)
Giardiasis (parasitic infection of the small intestine)

mechanismOfAction:
How SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET Works

SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET is an antiprotozoal agent that kills the parasites and bacteria by generating a harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria, resulting in disruption of bacterial or parasitic protein synthesis and its replication.
usageDetails:
How to use SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET

Take SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SECNIROBE 500MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RIFAXIMAX

RIFAXIMAX is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAXIMAX inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFAXIMAX
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAXIMAX Works

RIFAXIMAX is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: OCTENOXA Gel 20gm
introduction:
Introduction About OCTENOXA GEL

OCTENOXA GEL contains Octenidine which belongs to the group of medicines called Dihydropyridines. It is intended for use on acute skin lesions such as cuts, grazes, slight burns and sunburn. It also promotes wound healing and reduces itching.

Acute skin lesion is a condition in which the affected area of skin is abnormal in appearance or growth when compared to its surrounding tissues. It is characterised by redness or whitish discoloration with fluid filled cavities, itchiness, dry skin, burning sensation, peeling of skin, etc.

OCTENOXA GEL should be used with caution during pregnancy. Consult your doctor before using. OCTENOXA GEL should be used with caution in children (3-8years age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effect of using OCTENOXA GEL include skin irritation and allergic contact dermatitis (skin rash due to contact with some substances). Consult your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen or persist.
uses: Manage acute skin lesions such as cuts, grazes, slight burns and sunburn

mechanismOfAction:
How OCTENOXA GEL Works

OCTENOXA GEL works effectively as an antiseptic where Octenidine acts by destabilizing the plasma membrane of the microorganisms thereby inactivating the pathogens. It also acts as a moisturizer and forms a protective layer which manages bacterial entry.

How to use OCTENOXA GEL

Always use this medicine as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Disinfect the affected area and apply a thin layer of gel. Dressing or plaster can be given over that if required. Do not let the tip of the tube to touch the wound. Your doctor will prescribe the correct dose and duration of use depending on age and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION

DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION contains Daptomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the skin and soft tissues, blood and tissues covering the heart. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged between 1-17 years).

DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving this medicine even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before receiving DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems or muscle problems as a precaution. DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION is generally not recommend for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, pain and redness at the site of injection, urinary tract infection, increased fungal infections, anemia, constipation and pain in arms or legs. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Skin or soft tissue infections (Ex. cellulitis, erysipelas, impetigo, folliculitis, and furuncles and carbuncles)
Pericarditis (infections of tissues surrounding the heart)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION

It is used to manage the following bacterial infections:

Skin or soft tissue infections (Ex. cellulitis, erysipelas, impetigo, folliculitis, and furuncles and carbuncles)
Blood infections (Ex. sepsis)

mechanismOfAction:
How DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION Works

DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION is a powerful antibacterial agent. It kills the susceptible bacteria by disrupting the bacterial cell wall. This manages further bacterial growth and reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:
How to use DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION

DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not miss a dose or stop receiving DAPTOBIO 350MG INJECTION without consulting your doctor as it may worsen your condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET

SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET contains Secnidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antiprotozoals. It is used to manage urethritis and vaginitis (urethral and vaginal inflammation) due to trichomonas vaginalis, intestinal and hepatic amebiasis (liver infection) and giardiasis (parasitic infection of the small intestine due to giardia parasite).

SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have a history of blood dyscrasia (abnormal condition or disease of the blood) or wheat allergy (condition that is different from celiac disease). Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of unwanted effects. 

SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET is not recommended for use during the first trimester of pregnancy and it should be used with caution during pregnancy after the first trimester only if advised by the doctor. Also, it is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents.

The most common side effects of taking SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET are nausea, gastrointestinal disturbances, metallic taste sensation and inflammation of the mouth or tongue. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Urethritis and vaginitis (due to trichomonas vaginalis)
Giardiasis (parasitic infection of the small intestine)
usesDetails:

mechanismOfAction:
How SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET Works

SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET is an antiprotozoal agent that kills the parasites and bacteria by generating a harmful molecule which damages the DNA of the parasites and bacteria, resulting in disruption of bacterial or parasitic protein synthesis and its replication.

Take SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SECNIROBE 1000MG TABLET for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE

CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE.

CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE
Manage severe bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE Works

CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE

Take CLINDASURE 150MG CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION

TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION contains a medicine Tigecycline which belongs to a group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious infections such as complicated infection of the skin and soft tissues (the tissue below the skin), excluding diabetic foot infections.

TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION is also used to manage complicated infection in the abdomen. It is used when your doctor thinks that other antibiotics will not suit you.

Before receiving TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have liver diseases, slow or poor wound healing, diarrhoea, blockage of the bile ducts, allergy to tetracycline antibiotics or bleeding disorders.

TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breast-feeding women. TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION is not recommended for use in children below 8 years of age. TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION can be used in elderly patients, however, consult with your doctor before receiving.

The most common side effects of receiving TIGEPLUG 50MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, headache, injection site pain or inflammation or dizziness. Contact your doctor if the symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

introduction:
Introduction About CUZIL 600 TABLET

CUZIL 600 TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking CUZIL 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with CUZIL 600 TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take CUZIL 600 TABLET for more than 28 days. 

CUZIL 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. CUZIL 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking CUZIL 600 TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How CUZIL 600 TABLET Works

CUZIL 600 TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use CUZIL 600 TABLET

Take CUZIL 600 TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow CUZIL 600 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse CUZIL 600 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take CUZIL 600 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CUZIL 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))

Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking CUZIL 600 TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CUZIL 600 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

Introduction About RIFAXIGYL 200MG TABLET

RIFAXIGYL 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAXIGYL 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAXIGYL 200MG TABLET Works

RIFAXIGYL 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

introduction:
Introduction About MACFURAN 100MG CAPSULE

MACFURAN 100MG CAPSULE contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. MACFURAN 100MG CAPSULE may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

MACFURAN 100MG CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

MACFURAN 100MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. MACFURAN 100MG CAPSULE should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking MACFURAN 100MG CAPSULE are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE

CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain serious bacterial infections. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before taking CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have or ever had problems with your stomach or intestines (bowel disease, diarrhea), hay fever, asthma, eczema, intolerance to certain sugars, kidney, and liver problems. CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE should be used with caution in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before taking CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE.

CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. The most common side effects of taking CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE are diarrhea, stomach pain and abnormal liver function tests. Consult your doctor if your symptoms get worse or persist.
usesDetails:

Manage severe bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE Works

CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and works against the infection-causing bacteria.

Take CLINDANESS 300 CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow it with a full glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RIFASET 200MG TABLET

RIFASET 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFASET 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFASET 200MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFASET 200MG TABLET Works

RIFASET 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.
