introduction:
Introduction About COLIST 2MIU INJECTION

COLIST 2MIU INJECTION contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of serious bacterial infections when other antibiotics are not suitable. It is clinically effective in managing various infections caused by certain gram-negative bacteria, such as Aerobacter aerogenes, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

A bacterial infection can be defined as a proliferation of various harmful strains of bacteria in the body. They can affect any part(s) of the body, including the respiratory tract, urinary tract, eyes, ears, skin, soft tissue, or bones.

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before receiving COLIST 2MIU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. To avoid side effects, your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin and constantly monitor your kidney functions while receiving COLIST 2MIU INJECTION. You must also inform your doctor if you have any inherited blood or muscle disorders before receiving COLIST 2MIU INJECTION.

Do not take COLIST 2MIU INJECTION if you are allergic to any of the ingredients present in it. COLIST 2MIU INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if prescribed by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving COLIST 2MIU INJECTION are stomach upset, tingling sensation in the extremities, loss of sensation, fever, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Manages serious bacterial infections
mechanismOfAction:
How COLIST 2MIU INJECTION Works

COLIST 2MIU INJECTION kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.

name: Dalacin C 300mg Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION

DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious bacterial infections in adults and adolescents above 12 years of age. Bacterial infection occurs when bacteria enter the body, increasing in number and causing a reaction in the body. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before receiving DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had impaired kidney and liver function, gastrointestinal diseases (colon inflammation) or problems with muscle function (Parkinson’s disease, myasthenia gravis). DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, consult your doctor before receiving.

DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age. DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients above 60 years of age. The most common side effects of receiving DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION are nausea, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, blood abnormalities and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if your symptoms do not improve.
uses: Manage serious bacterial infections in adults and adolescents (over 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION
Manage serious bacterial infections in adults and adolescents (over 12 years of age)
mechanismOfAction:
How DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION Works

DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and kills the infection-causing bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION

DALACIN C 300MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse into your vein (intravenous infusion with a drip). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Gastrointestinal disorders (nausea, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea)
Severe or prolonged or bloody diarrhea during or after management may be a sign of bowel inflammation (pseudomembranous colitis)
Blood abnormalities (changes in the number of white blood cells or reduction in blood platelets (which increases the risk of bleeding or bruising))
Diseases of the blood vessels such as inflammation of the veins(thrombophlebitis).
Skin lesions with large blistering skin rash (maculopapular exanthema, morbilliform exanthema), ’nettle rash’ (urticaria)
The results of liver tests may be affected
Nervous system disturbances, such as an inhibiting nerve impulse progression (neuromuscular blocking effect) and altered taste (dysgeusia)
Pain and abscess at the site of injection
Stevens-Johnson syndrome (peeling of large areas of skin, especially around the mouth, nose, eyes, and genitals) and Lyell syndrome (a more serious illness with blistering of the skin)
Extensive red skin rash with skin flaking (exfoliative dermatitis, bullous dermatitis, erythema multiforme)
Serious allergic reaction which causes swelling of the face or throat(angioedema)

DAPTOJUB 350 INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving this medicine even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before receiving DAPTOJUB 350 INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems or muscle problems as a precaution. DAPTOJUB 350 INJECTION is generally not recommend for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DAPTOJUB 350 INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, pain and redness at the site of injection, urinary tract infection, increased fungal infections, anemia, constipation and pain in arms or legs. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION

ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION is a combination of Furazolidone and Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antimicrobial agents. It is used to manage diarrhoea and dysentery caused due to various bacterial and protozoal infections affecting the gut such as amoebiasis, colitis, cholera, bacteraemia salmonellosis or giardiasis (beaver fever causing stomach cramps, bloating and watery diarrhoea).

It can also be used to manage infections of the blood, brain, bones, teeth and genital areas. It also helps in managing gum inflammation, leg ulcers and pressure sores and manages post-surgical infections.

Take ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration as instructed by the doctor to achieve better results. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before taking ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain and headache. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.
uses: Diarrhoea and dysentery caused due to various bacterial and parasitic infections
Stomach infections (such as amoebiasis, giardiasis, bacterial enteritis)

Anaerobic infections (such as necrotizing pneumonia, osteomyelitis)
usesDetails:

Food poisoning

mechanismOfAction:
How ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION Works

ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION is an antimicrobial medication. It kills susceptible microorganisms by breaking down their genetic material (DNA). As a result, it reduces the severity of the infection and manages them from spreading further.
usageDetails:
How to use ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION

Take ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken with or just after meals. Shake the medicine well before use. Measure the required quantity of the medicine in the measuring cup and consume the medicine immediately.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending on your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not skip doses or stop taking ARISTOGYL F ORAL SUSPENSION without consulting your doctor as it may not completely manage the infection.

CUBICIN 350MG INJECTION contains Daptomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the skin and soft tissues, blood and tissues covering the heart. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged between 1-17 years).

CUBICIN 350MG INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving this medicine even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before receiving CUBICIN 350MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems or muscle problems as a precaution. CUBICIN 350MG INJECTION is generally not recommend for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving CUBICIN 350MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, pain and redness at the site of injection, urinary tract infection, increased fungal infections, anemia, constipation and pain in arms or legs. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION

DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION contains Clindamycin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage serious bacterial infections in adults and adolescents above 12 years of age. Bacterial infection occurs when bacteria enter the body, increasing in number and causing a reaction in the body. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, vomiting and swollen lymph nodes in the neck, armpits, groin or elsewhere.

Before receiving DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have or ever had impaired kidney and liver function, gastrointestinal diseases (colon inflammation) or problems with muscle function (Parkinson’s disease, myasthenia gravis). DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women, consult your doctor before receiving.

DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION is generally not recommended for use in children below 12 years of age. DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients above 60 years of age. The most common side effects of receiving DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION are nausea, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, blood abnormalities and skin rashes. Consult your doctor if your symptoms do not improve.
uses: Manage serious bacterial infections in adults and adolescents (over 12 years of age)
usesDetails:
Uses Of DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION
Manage serious bacterial infections in adults and adolescents (over 12 years of age)
mechanismOfAction:
How DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION Works

DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION acts against the bacteria by binding to the 50S subunit of the bacterial ribosome (site of protein synthesis). Which in turn manages protein synthesis and kills the infection-causing bacteria.

How to use DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION

DALACIN C 600MG INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse into your vein (intravenous infusion with a drip). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: RIFABIZ 200MG TABLET 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About RIFABIZ 200MG TABLET

RIFABIZ 200MG TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFABIZ 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFABIZ 200MG TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFABIZ 200MG TABLET Works

RIFABIZ 200MG TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: NIFTY SR Tablet 14's
introduction:
Introduction About NIFTY SR TABLET

NIFTY SR TABLET contains Nitrofurantoin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used in the management of urinary tract infections. It is an infection that occurs in any part of the urinary system including bladder, kidneys, ureters and urethra. It causes symptoms such as strong, continuous urge to urinate, burning sensation while urinating, decreased flow in urine, cloudy appearance of urine, blood in urine and pain in pelvic region, especially seen among women.

Your doctor will regularly test to know how your lungs and liver are working. NIFTY SR TABLET may also interfere with urine tests for sugar, resulting in a false positive result.

NIFTY SR TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with lung or liver disease, anaemia, diabetes (high blood sugar), any illness causing severe weakness, electrolyte imbalance and vitamin B deficiency and recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.

NIFTY SR TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women at the stage of labour or delivery because of the possibility that use at this stage may harm the baby and should be used with caution in breast-feeding women.

This medicine is avoided for use in infants below 3 months of age. NIFTY SR TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking NIFTY SR TABLET are nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite and diarrhoea. Talk to your doctor if any of the side effects gets worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How NIFTY SR TABLET Works

NIFTY SR TABLET effectively manages and manages urinary tract infection by killing bacteria present in the urethra, bladder, and/or kidneys. It mainly acts through disrupting the production of genetic material present in the bacterial cell.

NIFTY SR TABLET should always be taken with food or milk for effective working and to avoid stomach upset.

name: SULTACLIN 750 Tablet 6's
introduction:
Introduction About SULTACLIN 750 TABLET

SULTACLIN 750 TABLET contains Sultamicillin which belongs to the group of medicines called Penicillins. SULTACLIN 750 TABLET is used to manage upper respiratory tract infections (such as sinusitis, otitis media, tonsillitis), lower respiratory tract infections (such as bacterial pneumonias, bronchitis), urinary tract infections, pyelonephritis (inflammation of kidney), skin & soft tissue infections, and gonococcal infections (sexually transmitted disease) in affected individuals.

SULTACLIN 750 TABLET is also indicated in patients who require sulbactam/ampicillin therapy (antibacterial therapy) following initial therapy with intramuscular/intravenous sulbactam/ampicillin medicine. SULTACLIN 750 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Sultamicillin. It is also not recommended for use in patients with infectious mononucleosis (a viral infection), galactose intolerance, Lapp-lactase deficiency, and/or glucose-galactose malabsorption (rare hereditary problems).

Before taking SULTACLIN 750 TABLET, inform your doctor if you had previously suffered from hypersensitivity reactions (to penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and/or other beta-lactam antibiotic agents), and/or have kidney problems (such as severe renal impairment), and/or liver problems (such as liver dysfunction).

SULTACLIN 750 TABLET should be used with caution during pregnancy only if it is clearly necessary. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through breast milk.

SULTACLIN 750 TABLET should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) which is also advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years/above) after consulting the doctor.

The most common side effects of taking SULTACLIN 750 TABLET are headache, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, itching, and/or rashes. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsens.

name: METRIS Injection 100ml
introduction:
Introduction About METRIS INJECTION

METRIS INJECTION contains Metronidazole which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage various bacterial and parasitic infections in the body such as intra-abdominal infections (Ex. peritonitis, intra-abdominal abscess and liver abscess), skin and skin structure infections, genital tract infections (Ex. endometritis, endomyometritis, tubo-ovarian abscess), blood infections (Ex. sepsis), bone and joint infections, brain infections (Ex. meningitis), respiratory tract infections (Ex. pneumonia, lung abscess), and infections on the membranes covering the heart (endocarditis).

It may also reduce the incidence of post-surgical infections among patients undergoing abdominal, gynaecological, gastrointestinal or colorectal surgery. METRIS INJECTION is suitable for use both in adults and in children and used only when management with oral medicines is not possible.

METRIS INJECTION should be used under careful medical supervision. It is important to take the full course of the therapy to achieve better control over infection. Failure or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control. Avoid consumption of alcohol while receiving METRIS INJECTION as it could increase the risk of dizziness and drowsiness.

Before receiving METRIS INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any problems in your liver or kidneys. You must also inform your doctor if you have any problems in your nervous system, blood disorders or any genetic disorders as a precaution. Do not receive this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of receiving METRIS INJECTION are changes in taste, swollen and inflamed tongue, sore and dry mouth and muscle pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect troubles you.

mechanismOfAction:
How METRIS INJECTION Works

METRIS INJECTION is an antiprotozoal agent with antibacterial properties. It works by killing the bacteria and parasites that cause infections in the body. This destroys the infection causing germs within the body and manages their further growth and multiplication which therefore reduces the severity of the infection.

METRIS INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein as an intravenous infusion.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of infection. Do not stop therapy or skip doses in between the therapy to achieve better control over infection.

name: Genolid 600mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About GENOLID 600MG TABLET

GENOLID 600MG TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking GENOLID 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with GENOLID 600MG TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take GENOLID 600MG TABLET for more than 28 days. 

GENOLID 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. GENOLID 600MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking GENOLID 600MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take GENOLID 600MG TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking GENOLID 600MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)

Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking GENOLID 600MG TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of GENOLID 600MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

name: RIFAXIMED 400 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About RIFAXIMED 400 TABLET

RIFAXIMED 400 TABLET is used to manage hepatic encephalopathy. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of toxin-producing bacteria in the digestive tract.

Before taking RIFAXIMED 400 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding before taking this medicine. There is no proper information regarding the use of this medicine in children. It should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

The most common side effects are dizziness, nausea, peripheral edema, fluid accumulation in the stomach, fatigue, constipation, and stomach pain. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
usesDetails:
Uses Of RIFAXIMED 400 TABLET
Used to manage hepatic encephalopathy
mechanismOfAction:
How RIFAXIMED 400 TABLET Works

RIFAXIMED 400 TABLET is a broad-spectrum antibiotic used for gastrointestinal and liver diseases. It manages hepatic encephalopathy by managing the growth of ammonia (toxin)-producing bacteria in the digestive tract. This reduces toxin accumulation in the blood and eventually protects your body from the harmful effects of the accumulated toxins. As a result, it manages the onset of disorders caused due to toxin accumulation (such as hepatic encephalopathy) and reduces their recurrence.

name: Daptocure 350mg Injection 1'S
introduction:
Introduction About DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION

DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION contains Daptomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the skin and soft tissues, blood and tissues covering the heart. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged between 1-17 years).

DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving this medicine even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before receiving DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems or muscle problems as a precaution. DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION is generally not recommend for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, pain and redness at the site of injection, urinary tract infection, increased fungal infections, anemia, constipation and pain in arms or legs. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

It is used to manage the following bacterial infections:

mechanismOfAction:
How DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION Works

DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION is a powerful antibacterial agent. It kills the susceptible bacteria by disrupting the bacterial cell wall. This manages further bacterial growth and reduces the severity of the infection.
usageDetails:

DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein (intravenously).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and severity of the infection.

Do not miss a dose or stop receiving DAPTOCURE 350MG INJECTION without consulting your doctor as it may worsen your condition.

introduction:
Introduction About RIFAGUT MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

RIFAGUT MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) to manage infectious diarrhea. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics which works against the susceptible bacteria that causes infection by blocking the actions of certain enzymes in the bacteria that is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the growth and multiplication of the harmful bacteria in the gut and controls diarrhea.

Take RIFAGUT MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Inform your doctor if you can’t notice any improvement in your condition or if you feel worse after 3 days of therapy. It is not recommended for use in patients with bloody diarrhea or diarrhea accompanied by fever and in patients passing unformed (soft or liquid) stools for more than 8 times a day. It is also not suitable for use in patients having any stomach problems (such as constipation, vomiting, or stomach pain due to blockage in the gut).

Inform your doctor before taking RIFAGUT MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding women. This medicine may cause pink or reddish discoloration of urine. This usually disappears after discontinuation of the therapy. The most common side effects of taking headache, flatulence, stomach pain, constipation, urge to empty bowels and fever. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: RCIFAX XL MANGO FLAVOUR Suspension 200ml
introduction:
Introduction About RCIFAX XL MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION

RCIFAX XL MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION is used in adults and in children (aged 2 years or above) to manage infectious diarrhea. It contains Rifaximin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics which works against the susceptible bacteria that causes infection by blocking the actions of certain enzymes in the bacteria that is required for its survival. As a result, it stops the growth and multiplication of the harmful bacteria in the gut and controls diarrhea.

Take RCIFAX XL MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Inform your doctor if you can’t notice any improvement in your condition or if you feel worse after 3 days of therapy. It is not recommended for use in patients with bloody diarrhea or diarrhea accompanied by fever and in patients passing unformed (soft or liquid) stools for more than 8 times a day. It is also not suitable for use in patients having any stomach problems (such as constipation, vomiting, or stomach pain due to blockage in the gut).

Inform your doctor before taking RCIFAX XL MANGO FLAVOUR SUSPENSION if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or breastfeeding women. This medicine may cause pink or reddish discoloration of urine. This usually disappears after discontinuation of the therapy. The most common side effects of taking headache, flatulence, stomach pain, constipation, urge to empty bowels and fever. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

name: OLIMEX 600 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About OLIMEX 600 TABLET

OLIMEX 600 TABLET contains Linezolid, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections like pneumonia (nosocomial and community-acquired pneumonia), some infections in or under the skin (complicated skin and soft tissue infections), and blood infections. 

Bacterial infections are caused by the multiplication of specific harmful strains of bacteria anywhere in the body. It is generally characterized by fever, chills and sweat, swollen lymph nodes, sudden pain or its worsening, unexplained tiredness, headache, skin flushing or discomfort, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or stomach pain. 

Before taking OLIMEX 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, or heart problems, mental health problems (such as maniac depression, schizoaffective disorder), overactive thyroid, anemia, history of seizures, diarrhea, adrenal gland tumors (phaeochromocytoma), or carcinoid syndrome, and if you are prone to getting infections.

During management with OLIMEX 600 TABLET, your doctor might perform regular blood tests to monitor your blood count and your eyesight if you take OLIMEX 600 TABLET for more than 28 days. 

OLIMEX 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor, and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. OLIMEX 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age), and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking OLIMEX 600 TABLET are headache, dizziness, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, stomach pain, and indigestion. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLIMEX 600 TABLET Works

OLIMEX 600 TABLET works by binding to and inhibiting bacterial enzymes required in DNA synthesis, thus interrupting DNA replication and managing bacterial cell multiplication.
usageDetails:
How to use OLIMEX 600 TABLET

Take OLIMEX 600 TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow OLIMEX 600 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse OLIMEX 600 TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned on the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take OLIMEX 600 TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Avoid consumption of alcohol (especially draught beers and wine) while taking OLIMEX 600 TABLET.

OLIMEX 600 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking OLIMEX 600 TABLET.
OLIMEX 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

OLIMEX 600 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) due to the greater risk of developing blood dyscrasias (a condition that affects the blood, bone marrow, or lymph tissue). Consult your doctor before taking OLIMEX 600 TABLET.

Others

Are anemic (low red blood cells)
Are prone to getting infections

Have diarrhea

Have any scheduled surgery

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking OLIMEX 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines: 

Medicines used to manage a cold or flu (Ex. pseudoephedrine, phenylpropanolamine)
Medicines used to manage asthma (Ex. salbutamol, terbutaline, fenoterol)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. clomipramine, amitriptyline, doxepin, citalopram, dosulepin, fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, imipramine, lofepramine, paroxetine, and sertraline), monoamine oxidase inhibitors (MAOIs) (used to manage depression or Parkinson’s disease) (Ex. phenelzine, isocarboxazid, selegiline, and moclobemide)
Medicines used to manage migraines (Ex. sumatriptan, zolmitriptan)
Medicines used to manage sudden, severe allergic reactions (Ex. adrenaline (epinephrine))
Medicines that increase blood pressure (Ex. noradrenaline (norepinephrine), dopamine, and dobutamine)
Pethidine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)
Buspirone (used to manage anxiety disorders)
Warfarin (used to stop blood clotting)
Rifampicin (used to manage bacterial infections)

B. Drug-Food interactions: 

Avoid eating large amounts of mature cheese, yeast extracts, or soy bean extracts (Ex. soy sauce) while taking OLIMEX 600 TABLET, as it may react with a substance called tyramine, which is naturally present in some foods, and cause an increase in the blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of OLIMEX 600 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of an overdose are vomiting, shaking, unsteadiness, or lack of coordination.

Introduction About DAPMICIN 350MG INJECTION

DAPMICIN 350MG INJECTION contains Daptomycin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage bacterial infections of the skin and soft tissues, blood and tissues covering the heart. It is suitable for use both in adults and in children (aged between 1-17 years).

DAPMICIN 350MG INJECTION should be used under medical supervision. Do not stop receiving this medicine even if you feel better during the midway of the therapy. Failing to complete the full course of the therapy or skipping doses in between the therapy may not result in adequate infection control.

Before receiving DAPMICIN 350MG INJECTION inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems or muscle problems as a precaution. DAPMICIN 350MG INJECTION is generally not recommend for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving DAPMICIN 350MG INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, pain and redness at the site of injection, urinary tract infection, increased fungal infections, anemia, constipation and pain in arms or legs. Inform your doctor if they trouble you.

name: Colist 4.5Miu Injection 1's
introduction:
Introduction About COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION

COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION contains colistin, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antibiotics. It is used to manage certain forms of serious bacterial infections when other antibiotics are not suitable. It is clinically effective in managing various infections caused by certain gram-negative bacteria, such as Aerobacter aerogenes, Escherichia coli, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa.

A bacterial infection can be defined as a proliferation of various harmful strains of bacteria in the body. They can affect any part(s) of the body, including the respiratory tract, urinary tract, eyes, ears, skin, soft tissue, or bones.

Colistin is a polypeptide antibiotic. It binds to the susceptible bacteria and disrupts the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane. As a result, it makes the contents of the bacterial cell leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the toxins produced by the bacteria.

Before receiving COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any kidney problems. To avoid side effects, your doctor would prescribe a low dose of colistin and constantly monitor your kidney functions while receiving COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION. You must also inform your doctor if you have any inherited blood or muscle disorders before receiving COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION.

Do not take COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION if you are allergic to any of the ingredients present in it. COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION should be used in pregnant or breastfeeding women only if prescribed by the physician. The most common side effects of receiving COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION are stomach upset, tingling sensation in the extremities, loss of sensation, fever, or dizziness. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION Works

COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION kills the susceptible bacteria that causes infection. It acts by disrupting the composition (lipids and proteins) of the bacterial cell membrane and enters the bacterial cell. This causes the contents of the bacterial cell to leak out, which subsequently leads to bacterial killing. It may also inactivate the effects of toxins produced by the harmful bacteria.
usageDetails:
How to use COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION

COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or nurse into the vein (intravenously). Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and severity of infection.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interaction:

Before receiving COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Other antibiotics such as aminoglycosides (Ex. netilmicin, gentamicin, amikacin, and tobramycin), cephalosporins (Ex. cefixime, ceftriaxone), macrolides (Ex. azithromycin, clarithromycin, or erythromycin), or fluoroquinolones (ofloxacin, norfloxacin, and ciprofloxacin)
Muscle relaxant medications (used for relaxing muscles before surgery) Ex. atracurium, vecuronium

Overdosage:

COLIST 4.5MIU INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital, and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms. Symptoms of overdosage might include muscle weakness and breathing difficulties.
